jobs.title: Sales & Tender Manager 80-100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity We are looking for an experienced, enthusiastic, and highly motivated self-driven Sales & Tender Manager to strengthen the Global Competence Center Power Conversion Sales team part of Power Grids Grid Integration Business Unit.  At our company, we value diversity and believe in fostering an inclusive work environment. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds and genders to apply for this exciting opportunity.    In this position you are responsible for sales of the Grid Integration portfolio with focus on Power Conversion (Static Frequency and Power Quality System Applications) Solutions from lead generation to final negotiation, contract signature and handover to the execution team. During the sales pursuits you will be supported by an interdisciplinary tender team, which you in some cases will lead yourself, which will support during technical clarifications and commercial negotiations.   
• We offer an exciting opportunity for a passionate sales\/ tender person in a dynamic environment who also like to work hands on.      
• Your responsibilities Develop strong networks with Customers and Suppliers to gain valuable Market insights and identify future business opportunities Collaborate closely with the Front-End Sales team to transform leads into opportunities that drive our business forward Understand and empathize with Customer requirements and needs during the acquisition phase Shape innovative sales strategies, selecting winning solutions both commercially and technically Lead the sales and tender process, engaging capture teams where necessary, supported by a diverse interdisciplinary team including engineering, project management, legal, commercial, and supply chain management Prepare comprehensive, timely, and technically sound commercial offers Lead negotiations with Customers, addressing both technical and commercial aspects Ensure seamless integration of Supplier offers, risk assessment, mitigation strategies, and tender completeness Successfully transition negotiated projects to the project execution and engineering departments Your background Proven experience in Sales, Marketing, Tendering, Product Management, or a related field Bachelor's or master's degree in a relevant subject Fluency in English and German. Proficiency in other languages would be an advantage Exceptional communication skills, projecting confidence when engaging with Customers at all levels, from technical teams to top management Experience in Power Electronics, MV Frequency Converters, Power Quality applications, or Grid Integration is desirable Familiarity with the Power Generation or Grid Intertie Applications Market is an asset Skilled in collaborating within cross-functional, cross-border teams, while embracing flexible working arrangements Openness to travel approximately 20% of your working time   More about us Join us on this exciting journey as a Sales & Tender Manager and contribute to shaping the future of power electronics solutions. We look forward to receiving applications from a diverse range of candidates who share our commitment to innovation and excellence. Apply today to make your mark!

jobs.title: PMO Lead - Legal & Integrity Operations 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  We are looking for a PMO Lead who helps teams move faster, stay focused, and make better decisions. This role supports the Legal & Integrity transformation portfolio by bringing structure, clarity, and follow-through to important initiatives.  You will work closely with Legal, Integrity, Legal Operations Service Center, Legal Tech Lead, IS, AI teams, and external partners. Your job is to turn business needs into clear plans, connect the right people, and help initiatives land with measurable impact.  The PMO is not an administrative control function. It is a lean enablement function that helps teams execute well, remove blockers, and keep leadership informed.  How you'll make an impact  Keep one clear view of the transformation portfolio, including priorities, milestones, risks, and decisions  Help teams define simple plans with clear ownership, timelines, deliverables, and success criteria  Track progress, spot blockers early, and drive follow-through on actions and commitments  Prepare decision-ready updates for leadership, steering committees, and portfolio governance forums  Translate legal and operational needs into structured business and technical requirements  Act as a bridge between Legal, Integrity, Legal Tech, IS, AI teams, and vendors.   Support AI and legal tech initiatives by helping define use-cases, scope, requirements, and measurable outcomes  Use modern tools such as Microsoft 365, Loop, Power BI, and Copilot to reduce manual work and improve visibility    Your background  A bachelor's degree in business, technology, operations, project management, or a related field and equivalent practical experience   Approximately 5–10 years' experience in a multinational environment  Strong experience in project, program, or portfolio management  A practical, outcome-focused mindset and the ability to turn strategy into execution  Good business analysis skills, including requirements gathering, process mapping, and problem framing  Confidence working with senior stakeholders, project sponsors, technical teams, and external partners  Strong communication skills, especially the ability to simplify complex topics  Comfort working across business and technology teams  Experience with tools such as Power BI, Microsoft Teams, Loop, Copilot or similar collaboration and reporting tools  Interest in using AI to improve delivery, reporting, and ways of working  Fluency in English (communication with stakeholders on senior\/executive levels)    More about us   At Hitachi Energy, we are advancing a sustainable energy future for all. Together with customers and partners, we pioneer technologies and enable the digital transformation required to accelerate the energy transition. Joining our Legal & Integrity Operations team offers a unique opportunity to contribute to a transformation portfolio that drives efficiency, innovation, and collaboration across a global organization. You will work in a dynamic environment where continuous improvement, digital solutions, and AI-enabled ways of working are shaping the future of how we operate.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità 
• Stiamo cercando un PMO Lead che aiuta le squadre a muoversi più velocemente, rimanere concentrati e prendere decisioni migliori. Questo ruolo supporta il portafoglio di trasformazione Legal & Integrity portando struttura, chiarezza e follow-through a importanti iniziative. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con Legal, Integrity, Legal Operations Service Center, Legal Tech Lead, IS, AI team e partner esterni. Il vostro lavoro è quello di trasformare le esigenze aziendali in piani chiari, collegare le persone giuste, e aiutare le iniziative atterrare con un impatto misurabile. Il PMO non è una funzione di controllo amministrativo. Si tratta di una funzione di attivazione magra che aiuta le squadre a eseguire bene, rimuovere i bloccanti e mantenere la leadership informata. Mantenere una visione chiara del portafoglio di trasformazione, comprese le priorità, le pietre miliari, i rischi e le decisioni I team di aiuto definiscono piani semplici con chiara proprietà, tempeste, consegnabili e criteri di successo Traccia i progressi, bloccanti spot presto, e guida il follow-through su azioni e impegni Preparare gli aggiornamenti di decisione-ready per la leadership, comitati di guida e forum di governance del portafoglio Traduci esigenze legali e operative in esigenze aziendali strutturate e tecniche Act come un ponte Supporto AI e iniziative di tecnologia legale, aiutando a definire casi di utilizzo, portata, requisiti e risultati misurabili Utilizza strumenti moderni come Microsoft 365, Loop, Power BI e Copilot per ridurre il lavoro manuale e migliorare la visibilità Una laurea in business, tecnologia, operazioni, project management, o un campo correlato e un'esperienza pratica equivalente Approssimativamente 5-10 anni di esperienza in un ambiente multinazionale Forte esperienza nel progetto, nel programma o nella gestione del portafoglio Una mentalità pratica, focalizzata sui risultati e la capacità di trasformare la strategia in esecuzione Buone competenze di analisi aziendale, tra cui la raccolta dei requisiti, la mappatura dei processi e la creazione di problemi A Hitachi Energy stiamo promuovendo un futuro energetico sostenibile per tutti. Insieme a clienti e partner, pionieri delle tecnologie e consentiamo la trasformazione digitale necessaria per accelerare la transizione energetica. Unire il nostro team Legal & Integrity Operations offre un'opportunità unica per contribuire a un portafoglio di trasformazione che guida efficienza, innovazione e collaborazione in un'organizzazione globale. Potrai lavorare in un ambiente dinamico in cui il miglioramento continuo, le soluzioni digitali e i modi di lavoro abilitati all'intelligenza artificiale stanno plasmando il futuro di come operiamo.

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Nous cherchons un chef de PMO qui aide les équipes à bouger plus rapidement, à rester concentrées et à prendre de meilleures décisions. Ce rôle appuie le portefeuille de la transformation juridique et de l'intégrité en apportant une structure, une clarté et un suivi aux initiatives importantes. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le Centre de services juridiques, d'intégrité, d'opérations juridiques, le responsable technique juridique, les équipes d'IS, d'IA et des partenaires externes. Votre travail consiste à transformer les besoins des entreprises en plans clairs, à relier les bonnes personnes et à aider les initiatives à se poser avec un impact mesurable. Le BGP n'est pas une fonction de contrôle administratif. C'est une fonction d'activation maigre qui aide les équipes à bien exécuter, à supprimer les bloqueurs et à tenir le leadership informé. Comment avoir un impact Gardez une vue claire du portefeuille de transformation, y compris les priorités, les jalons, les risques et les décisions Aider les équipes à définir des plans simples avec une appropriation claire, des échéanciers, des livrables et des critères de réussite Suivre les progrès, les bloqueurs ponctuels tôt et diriger le suivi des actions et des engagements Préparer des mises à jour prêtes à prendre des décisions pour le leadership, les comités directeurs et les forums de gouvernance du portefeuille Traduire les besoins juridiques et opérationnels en exigences administratives et techniques structurées Agir comme un pont entre le juridique, l'intégrité, les techniciens juridiques, l'IS, les équipes d'IA et les fournisseurs. Soutenir les initiatives en matière d'IA et de technologie juridique en aidant à définir les cas d'utilisation, la portée, les exigences et les résultats mesurables Utilisez des outils modernes tels que Microsoft 365, Loop, Power BI et Copilot pour réduire le travail manuel et améliorer la visibilité Votre expérience Baccalauréat en affaires, en technologie, en opérations, en gestion de projet, ou dans un domaine connexe et expérience pratique équivalente Environ 5 à 10 ans d'expérience dans un environnement multinational Forte expérience en gestion de projet, de programme ou de portefeuille Un état d'esprit pratique axé sur les résultats et la capacité de transformer la stratégie en exécution Bonnes compétences en analyse des affaires, y compris la collecte d'exigences, la cartographie des processus et l'élaboration des problèmes Confiance en collaboration avec les principaux intervenants, les promoteurs de projet, les équipes techniques et les partenaires externes Fortes compétences en communication, en particulier la capacité de simplifier des sujets complexes Confort en collaboration avec les équipes d'affaires et de technologie Expérience avec des outils tels que Power BI, Microsoft Teams, Loop, Copilot ou des outils similaires de collaboration et de rapport Intérêt à utiliser l'IA pour améliorer la prestation, l'établissement de rapports et les méthodes de travail Fluency en anglais (communication avec les intervenants aux niveaux supérieur et exécutif) Plus sur nous Chez Hitachi Energy, nous faisons avancer un avenir énergétique durable pour tous. Avec nos clients et nos partenaires, nous sommes les pionniers des technologies et nous permettons la transformation numérique nécessaire pour accélérer la transition énergétique. Le fait de rejoindre notre équipe des opérations juridiques et d'intégrité offre une occasion unique de contribuer à un portefeuille de transformation qui stimule l'efficacité, l'innovation et la collaboration dans une organisation mondiale. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement dynamique où l'amélioration continue, les solutions numériques et les méthodes de travail adaptées à l'IA façonnent l'avenir de notre fonctionnement.

jobs.title: Financial Planning Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are seeking a Financial Planning Lead to own and continuously enhance the financial planning and forecasting agenda. This role partners closely with the CFO, Head of FP&A, and senior leadership to translate business strategy into robust financial plans, actionable insights, and clear performance narratives. The successful candidate will lead and develop the team responsible for budget and forecast cycles, with a strong focus on accuracy, efficiency, business partnering, and the practical application of technology, automation, and AI to modernize planning processes. This position can be performed remotely within Europe. Please submit your application documents in English. How you'll make an impact Lead the end-to-end budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and a clear articulation of key assumptions, risks, opportunities, and business drivers. Partner with Finance Leadership to deliver strategic analysis, scenario modelling, and high-quality executive deliverables that support business decisions and external communications. Build strong relationships with business units and functional finance teams to understand business needs, strengthen data quality, and provide relevant insights that improve decision-making. Act as a key liaison with Headquarters in Tokyo, providing timely reporting, clear communication, and well-structured responses to inquiries to support alignment on performance, strategy, and priorities. Manage, develop, and coach the planning team to deliver high-quality outputs efficiently while building strong technical, analytical, business partnering, and continuous improvement capabilities. Support strategic initiatives with robust financial analysis, clear recommendations, and commercially relevant insights. Bring hands-on experience applying AI in financial planning, such as driver-based forecasting, scenario analysis, anomaly detection, predictive insights, workflow automation, and  management reporting. Own relevant FP&A applications in close collaboration with IT, ensuring tools are fit for purpose, well governed, and effectively adopted by users. Identify, design, and implement automation and process improvement opportunities that enhance the speed, accuracy, transparency, and insightfulness of planning and forecasting outputs. Champion the adoption and optimization of planning, forecasting, analytics, and AI-enabled tools to support modern, agile, and forward-looking finance processes. Your background Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related discipline; MBA or professional finance qualification (CFA, CPA, CIMA) preferred. 10+ years of experience in FP&A, including deep involvement in planning, forecasting, and performance management in complex, global organizations. Proven track record of managing and developing high-performing teams to deliver accurate and insightful outputs efficiently. Strong technical proficiency in planning systems, data visualization tools, and modern finance technology platforms. Hands-on experience using AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics to improve planning quality, forecasting accuracy, scenario modelling, decision support, or reporting efficiency. Demonstrated ability to drive process automation, digital transformation, and technology-enabled improvements in finance. Exceptional attention to detail, analytical rigor, and commitment to high standards. Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate financial data into clear insights and influence senior stakeholders. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under tight deadlines. More about us We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità 
• Stiamo cercando una pianificazione finanziaria portare a possedere e migliorare continuamente la pianificazione finanziaria e l'agenda di previsione. Questo ruolo collabora a stretto contatto con il CFO, capo di FP&A e leadership senior per tradurre la strategia aziendale in piani finanziari robusti, intuizioni attuabili e chiare narrazioni di performance. Il candidato di successo porterà e svilupperà il team responsabile dei cicli di budget e previsioni, con un forte focus su accuratezza, efficienza, business partnering, e l'applicazione pratica di tecnologia, automazione e AI per modernizzare i processi di pianificazione. Questa posizione può essere eseguita da remoto in Europa. Si prega di inviare i documenti di richiesta in inglese. Come farete un impatto Condurre il budgeting end-to-end, la previsione e i processi di pianificazione a lungo raggio, assicurando l'allineamento con gli obiettivi strategici e una chiara articolazione di assunti chiave, rischi, opportunità e driver aziendali. Partner con Finance Leadership per fornire analisi strategiche, modellizzazione degli scenari e consegnabili executive di alta qualità che supportano le decisioni aziendali e le comunicazioni esterne. Costruire relazioni forti con le unità aziendali e i team di finanza funzionale per comprendere le esigenze aziendali, rafforzare la qualità dei dati e fornire informazioni rilevanti che migliorano il processo decisionale. Agire come un collegamento chiave con il quartier generale a Tokyo, fornendo report tempestivi, comunicazione chiara e risposte ben strutturate alle indagini per sostenere l'allineamento sulle prestazioni, la strategia e le priorità. Gestire, sviluppare e allenare il team di pianificazione per fornire output di alta qualità in modo efficiente, mentre la costruzione di forti capacità tecniche, analitiche, di business partnering e di miglioramento continuo. Sostenere iniziative strategiche con analisi finanziarie robuste, raccomandazioni chiare e approfondimenti commercialmente rilevanti. Porta l'esperienza pratica nell'applicazione dell'IA nella pianificazione finanziaria, come la previsione basata sul driver, l'analisi dello scenario, il rilevamento di anomalia, le intuizioni predittive, l'automazione del flusso di lavoro e il reporting di gestione. Possedere applicazioni FP&A pertinenti in stretta collaborazione con IT, assicurando che gli strumenti siano adatti a scopo, ben governati e efficacemente adottati dagli utenti. Identificare, progettare e implementare opportunità di automazione e miglioramento dei processi che migliorano la velocità, l'accuratezza, la trasparenza e l'intuizione delle uscite di pianificazione e di previsione. Campioni l'adozione e l'ottimizzazione di pianificazione, previsione, analisi e strumenti AI-enabled per supportare i processi finanziari moderni, agili e previsionali. La tua laurea di primo livello in Finanza, Contabilità o disciplina relativa; MBA o qualifica di finanza professionale (CFA, CPA, CIMA) preferito. 10+ anni di esperienza in FP&A, tra cui un profondo coinvolgimento nella pianificazione, previsione e gestione delle prestazioni in organizzazioni complesse e globali. Provato record di traccia di gestione e sviluppo di team ad alte prestazioni per fornire uscite accurate e intuitive in modo efficiente. Forte competenza tecnica nei sistemi di pianificazione, strumenti di visualizzazione dei dati e piattaforme tecnologiche finanziarie moderne. Esperienza pratica utilizzando AI, machine learning o analisi avanzate per migliorare la qualità di pianificazione, la precisione di previsione, la modellazione di scenari, il supporto decisionale o l'efficienza di reporting. Dimostrata capacità di guidare l'automazione del processo, la trasformazione digitale, e miglioramenti tecnologici in grado di finanziare. Eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli, rigore analitico, e l'impegno a standard elevati. Forte capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di tradurre i dati finanziari in chiare intuizioni e influenzare gli stakeholder senior. Capacità di gestire più priorità e di consegnare sotto scadenze strette. Crediamo che il grande lavoro prosperi in un ambiente in cui le persone si sentono sinceramente sostenute e abbastanza ricompensate. I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per creare valore reale per ogni individuo – il rifornimento di impegno, le prestazioni e la crescita. Con la priorità del benessere, costruiamo un posto di lavoro dove il successo personale e organizzativo crescono
descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity We are seeking a Financial Planning Lead to own and continuously enhance the financial planning and forecasting agenda. This role partners closely with the CFO, Head of FP&A, and senior leadership to translate business strategy into robust financial plans, actionable insights, and clear performance narratives. The successful candidate will lead and develop the team responsible for budget and forecast cycles, with a strong focus on accuracy, efficiency, business partnering, and the practical application of technology, automation, and AI to modernize planning processes. This position can be performed remotely within Europe. Please submit your application documents in English. How you'll make an impact Lead the end-to-end budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and a clear articulation of key assumptions, risks, opportunities, and business drivers. Partner with Finance Leadership to deliver strategic analysis, scenario modelling, and high-quality executive deliverables that support business decisions and external communications. Build strong relationships with business units and functional finance teams to understand business needs, strengthen data quality, and provide relevant insights that improve decision-making. Act as a key liaison with Headquarters in Tokyo, providing timely reporting, clear communication, and well-structured responses to inquiries to support alignment on performance, strategy, and priorities. Manage, develop, and coach the planning team to deliver high-quality outputs efficiently while building strong technical, analytical, business partnering, and continuous improvement capabilities. Support strategic initiatives with robust financial analysis, clear recommendations, and commercially relevant insights. Bring hands-on experience applying AI in financial planning, such as driver-based forecasting, scenario analysis, anomaly detection, predictive insights, workflow automation, and management reporting. Own relevant FP&A applications in close collaboration with IT, ensuring tools are fit for purpose, well governed, and effectively adopted by users. Identify, design, and implement automation and process improvement opportunities that enhance the speed, accuracy, transparency, and insightfulness of planning and forecasting outputs. Champion the adoption and optimization of planning, forecasting, analytics, and AI-enabled tools to support modern, agile, and forward-looking finance processes. Your background Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related discipline; MBA or professional finance qualification (CFA, CPA, CIMA) preferred. 10+ years of experience in FP&A, including deep involvement in planning, forecasting, and performance management in complex, global organizations. Proven track record of managing and developing high-performing teams to deliver accurate and insightful outputs efficiently. Strong technical proficiency in planning systems, data visualization tools, and modern finance technology platforms. Hands-on experience using AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics to improve planning quality, forecasting accuracy, scenario modelling, decision support, or reporting efficiency. Demonstrated ability to drive process automation, digital transformation, and technology-enabled improvements in finance. Exceptional attention to detail, analytical rigor, and commitment to high standards. Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate financial data into clear insights and influence senior stakeholders. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under tight deadlines. More about us We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Wir suchen einen Financial Planning Lead, um die Finanzplanungs- und Prognoseagenda zu besitzen und kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Diese Rolle arbeitet eng mit dem CFO, dem Leiter von FP & A und der leitenden Führung zusammen, um die Geschäftsstrategie in robuste Finanzpläne, umsetzbare Erkenntnisse und klare Performance-Narrative umzusetzen. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird das Team leiten und entwickeln, das für Budget- und Prognosezyklen verantwortlich ist, mit einem starken Fokus auf Genauigkeit, Effizienz, Geschäftspartnerschaft und die praktische Anwendung von Technologie, Automatisierung und KI zur Modernisierung von Planungsprozessen. Diese Position kann aus der Ferne innerhalb Europas ausgeübt werden. Bitte reichen Sie Ihre Bewerbungsunterlagen in englischer Sprache ein. Führen Sie die End-to-End-Budgetierung, Prognose und langfristige Planungsprozesse, um die Ausrichtung auf strategische Ziele und eine klare Artikulation der wichtigsten Annahmen, Risiken, Chancen und Geschäftstreiber sicherzustellen. Partnerschaft mit Finance Leadership, um strategische Analysen, Szenariomodellierung und qualitativ hochwertige Führungskräfte zu liefern, die Geschäftsentscheidungen und externe Kommunikation unterstützen. Aufbau starker Beziehungen zu Geschäftseinheiten und funktionalen Finanzteams, um die Geschäftsanforderungen zu verstehen, die Datenqualität zu stärken und relevante Erkenntnisse zu liefern, die die Entscheidungsfindung verbessern. Funktionieren Sie als zentrale Verbindung mit dem Hauptsitz in Tokio und bieten Sie zeitnahe Berichte, eine klare Kommunikation und gut strukturierte Antworten auf Anfragen, um die Ausrichtung auf Leistung, Strategie und Prioritäten zu unterstützen. Verwalten, entwickeln und coachen Sie das Planungsteam, um qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse effizient zu liefern und gleichzeitig starke technische, analytische, Geschäftspartner- und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsfähigkeiten aufzubauen. Unterstützen Sie strategische Initiativen mit robusten Finanzanalysen, klaren Empfehlungen und kommerziell relevanten Erkenntnissen. Bringen Sie praktische Erfahrungen mit der Anwendung von KI in der Finanzplanung mit, z. B. treiberbasierte Prognosen, Szenarioanalysen, Anomalieerkennung, prädiktive Erkenntnisse, Workflow-Automatisierung und Management-Reporting. Eigene relevante FP & A-Anwendungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der IT, um sicherzustellen, dass die Tools für den Zweck geeignet sind, gut verwaltet und von den Benutzern effektiv übernommen werden. Identifizieren, entwerfen und implementieren Sie Automatisierungs- und Prozessverbesserungsmöglichkeiten, die die Geschwindigkeit, Genauigkeit, Transparenz und Aufschlussreichkeit der Planungs- und Prognoseergebnisse verbessern. Verfechten Sie die Einführung und Optimierung von Planungs-, Prognose-, Analyse- und KI-fähigen Tools zur Unterstützung moderner, agiler und zukunftsweisender Finanzprozesse. Ihr Bachelor-Abschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder verwandten Disziplinen; MBA oder professionelle Finanzqualifikation (CFA, CPA, CIMA) bevorzugt. 10+ Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich FP&A, einschließlich einer umfassenden Beteiligung an Planung, Prognose und Leistungsmanagement in komplexen, globalen Organisationen. Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Verwaltung und Entwicklung leistungsstarker Teams, um genaue und aufschlussreiche Ergebnisse effizient zu liefern. Starke technische Kenntnisse in Planungssystemen, Datenvisualisierungstools und modernen Finanztechnologieplattformen. Praktische Erfahrung mit KI, maschinellem Lernen oder fortschrittlichen Analysen zur Verbesserung der Planungsqualität, Prognosegenauigkeit, Szenariomodellierung, Entscheidungsunterstützung oder Berichtseffizienz. Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, Prozessautomatisierung, digitale Transformation und technologiegestützte Verbesserungen im Finanzwesen voranzutreiben. Außergewöhnliche Liebe zum Detail, analytische Strenge und Verpflichtung zu hohen Standards. Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Finanzdaten in klare Erkenntnisse zu übersetzen und leitende Stakeholder zu beeinflussen. Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten zu verwalten und unter engen Fristen zu liefern. Wir glauben, dass großartige Arbeit in einem Umfeld gedeiht, in dem sich die Menschen wirklich unterstützt und fair belohnt fühlen. Unsere Vorteile sind so konzipiert, dass sie für jeden Einzelnen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen – und so Engagement, Leistung und Wachstum fördern. Durch die Priorisierung des Wohlbefindens schaffen wir einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem der persönliche und organisatorische Erfolg wächst
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Nous cherchons un chef de file de la planification financière afin d'améliorer continuellement le programme de planification et de prévision financières. Ce rôle collabore étroitement avec le DPF, le chef du FP&A et les cadres supérieurs pour traduire la stratégie opérationnelle en plans financiers solides, en idées pratiques et en récits de rendement clairs. Le candidat retenu dirigera et développera l'équipe responsable des cycles budgétaires et prévisionnels, en mettant fortement l'accent sur l'exactitude, l'efficacité, le partenariat d'affaires et l'application pratique de la technologie, de l'automatisation et de l'IA pour moderniser les processus de planification. Cette position peut être réalisée à distance en Europe. Veuillez soumettre vos documents de candidature en anglais. Comment vous ferez un impact Dirigez les processus de budgétisation de bout en bout, de prévision et de planification à long terme, en assurant l'alignement sur les objectifs stratégiques et en articulant clairement les principales hypothèses, les risques, les possibilités et les moteurs d'affaires. S'associer au leadership financier pour réaliser des analyses stratégiques, des modèles de scénarios et des produits livrables de haute qualité qui appuient les décisions opérationnelles et les communications externes. Établir des relations solides avec les unités opérationnelles et les équipes fonctionnelles de financement pour comprendre les besoins des entreprises, renforcer la qualité des données et fournir des renseignements pertinents qui améliorent la prise de décisions. Agir en tant que liaison clé avec le Siège à Tokyo, en fournissant des rapports en temps opportun, des communications claires et des réponses bien structurées aux demandes de renseignements afin d'appuyer l'harmonisation des résultats, des stratégies et des priorités. Gérer, développer et entraîner l'équipe de planification afin d'offrir des extrants de haute qualité efficacement tout en créant de solides capacités techniques, analytiques, de partenariat d'affaires et d'amélioration continue. Appuyer les initiatives stratégiques avec une analyse financière solide, des recommandations claires et des idées pertinentes sur le plan commercial. Mettre à profit l'expérience pratique de l'application de l'IA dans la planification financière, comme la prévision basée sur les conducteurs, l'analyse de scénarios, la détection d'anomalies, les prévisions, l'automatisation des flux de travail et les rapports de gestion. Posséder des applications pertinentes de la FP&A en étroite collaboration avec la TI, en veillant à ce que les outils soient adaptés à des fins précises, bien gouvernés et effectivement adoptés par les utilisateurs. Identifier, concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des possibilités d'automatisation et d'amélioration des processus qui améliorent la rapidité, la précision, la transparence et la perspicacité des extrants de planification et de prévision. Promouvoir l'adoption et l'optimisation d'outils de planification, de prévision, d'analyse et d'intelligence artificielle pour soutenir les processus financiers modernes, agiles et prospectifs. Votre formation Baccalauréat en finance, comptabilité ou discipline connexe; MBA ou qualification en finance professionnelle (CFA, CPA, CIMA) préféré. 10 ans et plus d'expérience en FP&A, y compris une participation active à la planification, à la prévision et à la gestion du rendement dans des organisations complexes et mondiales. Expérience éprouvée de la gestion et du développement d'équipes performantes afin d'obtenir des résultats précis et éclairés. Forte compétence technique dans les systèmes de planification, les outils de visualisation des données et les plates-formes technologiques de financement modernes. Expérience pratique en utilisant l'intelligence artificielle, l'apprentissage automatique ou l'analyse avancée pour améliorer la qualité de la planification, l'exactitude des prévisions, la modélisation de scénarios, le soutien à la décision ou l'efficacité des rapports. Capacité démontrée de stimuler l'automatisation des processus, la transformation numérique et l'amélioration technologique des finances. Une attention exceptionnelle au détail, à la rigueur analytique et à l'engagement envers des normes élevées. De solides compétences en communication, avec la capacité de traduire les données financières en idées claires et d'influencer les principaux intervenants. Capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités et de respecter des délais serrés. Plus sur nous Nous croyons que le grand travail prospère dans un environnement où les gens se sentent véritablement soutenus et équitablement récompensés. Nos avantages sont conçus pour créer une valeur réelle pour chaque individu – alimenter l'engagement, la performance et la croissance. En privilégiant le bien-être, nous construisons un milieu de travail où la réussite personnelle et organisationnelle s'accroît

jobs.title: Forex Exposure & Special Projects Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The Opportunity Are you ready to make a global impact in Treasury and Corporate Finance? We are looking for an experienced Treasury and Financial Risk Management professional to lead global Forex exposure reporting and support strategic corporate finance initiatives. In this role, you will strengthen global financial risk reporting, governance, and treasury-related processes while supporting funding, capital structure, and strategic transaction activities across a complex international business environment. How you'll make an impact Lead and continuously improve global FX and commodity exposure reporting standards. Harmonize exposure reporting and governance across Treasury, Finance, and Global Business Units. Enhance reporting frameworks in line with company policies and financial risk management standards. Support complex projects involving hedging strategies, multi-currency cash flow planning, and treasury risk management. Drive effective use of S\/4HANA, Treasury Management Systems, and reporting tools to monitor exposures. Ensure strong governance, internal controls, and adherence to treasury best practices. Develop reporting dashboards, KPIs, and training programs for global stakeholders. Contribute to strategic corporate finance initiatives, including funding projects and M&A activities. Your background Degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Treasury, or a related field. Professional treasury or finance certification (e.g., ACT, CTP, CFA) is a plus. 10+ years of experience in Treasury, Financial Risk Management, Corporate Finance, or related areas. Strong knowledge of FX exposure management, hedging instruments, commodity risk, liquidity, and treasury governance. Experience with ERP and treasury systems, ideally including S\/4HANA and Treasury Management Systems. Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex topics into actionable insights. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills in an international environment. Fluent English; additional languages are considered an advantage.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Sei pronto a fare un impatto globale nel settore del Tesoro e delle finanze aziendali? Siamo alla ricerca di un professionista esperto di gestione del Tesoro e del rischio finanziario per guidare la segnalazione globale di esposizione Forex e sostenere iniziative strategiche di finanza aziendale. In questo ruolo, rafforzerai la reportistica finanziaria globale dei rischi, la governance e i processi legati al tesoro, supportando al contempo finanziamenti, struttura dei capitali e attività di transazione strategica in un complesso ambiente aziendale internazionale. Come farete un impatto Piombo e migliorare continuamente gli standard globali di reporting FX e di esposizione delle merci. Armonizzare la segnalazione e la governance dell'esposizione attraverso il Tesoro, le Finanze e le Global Business Units. Migliorare i framework di reporting in linea con le politiche aziendali e gli standard di gestione dei rischi finanziari. Sostenere progetti complessi che coinvolgono strategie di copertura, pianificazione del flusso di cassa multivaluta e gestione del rischio tesoreria. Utilizzare efficacemente S\/4HANA, Sistemi di Gestione del Tesoro e strumenti di reportistica per monitorare le esposizioni. Assicurare una forte governance, controlli interni e l'adesione alle migliori pratiche del tesoro. Sviluppare dashboard di report, KPI e programmi di formazione per gli stakeholder globali. Contribuisci a iniziative strategiche di finanza aziendale, inclusi progetti di finanziamento e attività M&A. La tua laurea in Finanza, Economia, Business Administration, Contabilità, Tesoro, o un campo relativo. La certificazione professionale di tesoreria o finanza (ad esempio, ACT, CTP, CFA) è un plus. 10+ anni di esperienza in tesoreria, gestione del rischio finanziario, finanza aziendale o aree correlate. Forte conoscenza della gestione dell'esposizione FX, strumenti di copertura, rischio di merce, liquidità e governance del tesoro. Esperienza con sistemi ERP e tesoreria, idealmente compresi S\/4HANA e Sistemi di gestione del Tesoro. Forte capacità analitiche con la capacità di tradurre argomenti complessi in insights attuabili. Eccellente capacità di gestione e comunicazione degli stakeholder in un ambiente internazionale. Inglese fluente; lingue aggiuntive sono considerate un vantaggio.

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Finanz- und Finanzrisikomanagement-Experten, der die globale Forex-Exposure-Berichterstattung leitet und strategische Unternehmensfinanzierungsinitiativen unterstützt. In dieser Rolle stärken Sie globale Finanzrisikoberichterstattung, Governance und Treasury-bezogene Prozesse und unterstützen Finanzierungs-, Kapitalstruktur- und strategische Transaktionsaktivitäten in einem komplexen internationalen Geschäftsumfeld. Verbesserung des Berichtsrahmens im Einklang mit den Unternehmenspolitiken und den Standards für das Finanzrisikomanagement. Unterstützen Sie komplexe Projekte mit Hedging-Strategien, Multi-Währungs-Cashflow-Planung und Treasury-Risikomanagement. descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à avoir un impact mondial sur le Trésor et les Finances? Nous sommes à la recherche d'un professionnel expérimenté de la gestion des risques financiers et de la trésorerie qui dirigera l'établissement de rapports sur l'exposition globale au Forex et soutiendra les initiatives stratégiques de financement des entreprises. Dans ce rôle, vous renforcerez l'information sur les risques financiers mondiaux, la gouvernance et les processus liés à la trésorerie tout en appuyant les activités de financement, la structure des immobilisations et les opérations stratégiques dans un environnement commercial international complexe. Comment vous allez faire un impact Le plomb et améliorer continuellement les normes mondiales de déclaration de l'exposition aux FX et aux matières premières. Harmoniser les rapports d'exposition et la gouvernance entre les unités du Trésor, des Finances et des Affaires mondiales. Améliorer les cadres de rapport conformément aux politiques de l'entreprise et aux normes de gestion des risques financiers. Appuyer des projets complexes comprenant des stratégies de couverture, la planification des flux de trésorerie multidevises et la gestion des risques de trésorerie. Encourager l'utilisation efficace de S\/4HANA, des systèmes de gestion de la trésorerie et des outils de déclaration pour surveiller les expositions. Assurer une gouvernance solide, des contrôles internes et le respect des pratiques exemplaires en matière de trésorerie. Élaborer des tableaux de bord, des ICR et des programmes de formation pour les intervenants mondiaux. Contribuer aux initiatives stratégiques de financement de l'entreprise, y compris les projets de financement et les activités de fusion-acquisition. Votre formation Diplôme en finance, économie, administration des affaires, comptabilité, Trésorerie, ou un domaine connexe. La certification professionnelle de trésorerie ou de finance (p. ex., ACT, CTP, FCA) est un plus. 10 ans et plus d'expérience en Trésorerie, gestion des risques financiers, finances générales ou domaines connexes. Connaissance approfondie de la gestion des expositions FX, des instruments de couverture, du risque de produits de base, de la liquidité et de la gouvernance de la trésorerie. Expérience des systèmes ERP et de trésorerie, incluant idéalement les systèmes S\/4HANA et de gestion de la trésorerie. Des compétences analytiques solides avec la capacité de traduire des sujets complexes en idées pratiques. Excellentes compétences en gestion des intervenants et en communication dans un environnement international. Anglais fluent; les langues supplémentaires sont considérées comme un avantage.

jobs.title: Wartungstechniker/in Fertigungsanlagen 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position In unserem Werk BiMOS Backend in Lenzburg stellen wir effiziente und hochwertige Leistungshalbleiter für den Einsatz in Motorensteuerungen und Wechselrichtersystemen her. Damit leisten wir einen entscheidenden Beitrag, die Industrie, den öffentlichen und individuellen Verkehr energieeffizienter zu gestalten und andererseits ermöglicht unsere Technologie das Produzieren und Transportieren von erneuerbaren Energien vom Produktionsstandort hin zum Verbraucher. Werde Teil der Energiewende und unterstütze uns, die Verfügbarkeit unserer Fertigungsanlagen zu erhalten und verbessern. Das kannst du bewirken Geplante Instandhaltung, Wartung und Inspektion: Regelmässige und zustandsabhängige Massnahmen zur Vermeidung von Ausfallzeiten und Sicherung der Anlagenverfügbarkeit durchführen gemäss allgemeinen Vorgaben, spezifischer Instandhaltungsanweisung, Dokumentation von Abweichungen und Planung der Leitung Instandhaltung Kalibrierung von Anlagen und Komponenten: Sicherstellung der präzisen Funktionsfähigkeit von Systemen zur Maximierung der Produktionsqualität und -leistung Verwaltung von Ersatz- und Verbrauchsmaterialien: Optimierte Materialbewirtschaftung für eine reibungslose Produktion Proaktive Informationsweitergabe: Laufende Berichterstattung über durchgeführte Arbeiten zur Unterstützung einer effizienten Planung und Umsetzung Qualitätskontrolle: Nachhaltige Inspektion der (selbst) durchgeführten Wartungsarbeiten sowie Anlagen- und Prozessfreigaben mittels Funktionstests und statistischer Prozesskontrolle (SPC) um höchste Produktionsstandards sicherzustellen Schulung des Personals: Weiterbildung der Schichtmitarbeiter im technischen Bereich, um Wissen zu teilen und Prozesssicherheit zu gewährleisten Technische Dokumentation: Dokumentation der durchgeführten Instandhaltungsarbeiten und Identifikation von Abweichungen in Wartungs- und Arbeitsunterlagen zu deren Verbesserung Sicherstellung der Arbeitssicherheit: Einhaltung und Überwachung von Sicherheits-, Gesundheits- und Umweltschutzrichtlinien zur Gewährleistung eines sicheren Arbeitsumfeldes Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung EFZ oder EBA im technisch-mechanischen Bereich Erfahrung im Bereich Instandhaltung, idealerweise in einem automatisierten Umfeld Zuverlässige, gründliche und effiziente Arbeitsweise nach Vorgabe und Anweisung zur nachhaltigen Umsetzung der präventiven Instandhaltungsarbeiten Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen geplanten Sondereinsätzen Bereitschaft zur eigenen kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung und Schulung Deutsch mindestens C1, Englisch mindestens A2 Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy steht für innovative Technologien und nachhaltige Energielösungen weltweit. Bei uns erwartet dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen, spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen.

titleByLocale.fr: Technicien d'entretien/dans les usines de fabrication 80 - 100% (p/m/j)

descriptionByLocale.it: Nel nostro impianto BiMOS Backend di Lenzburg, produciamo semiconduttori di potenza efficienti e di alta qualità per l'uso nei sistemi di controllo motori e nei sistemi di inverter. In questo modo, forniamo un contributo decisivo per rendere più efficiente l'industria, il trasporto pubblico e individuale e, d'altra parte, la nostra tecnologia consente la produzione e il trasporto di energie rinnovabili dal sito produttivo al consumatore. Entrate a far parte della transizione energetica e sosteneteci nel mantenere e migliorare la disponibilità delle nostre strutture produttive. È possibile raggiungere questo Piano di Manutenzione, Manutenzione e Ispezione: misure regolari e dipendenti dalle condizioni per evitare i tempi di fermo e garantire la disponibilità degli impianti eseguire secondo specifiche generali, specifiche istruzioni di manutenzione, documentazione di deviazioni e pianificazione della gestione Calibrazione di impianti e componenti: Garantire la precisa funzionalità dei sistemi per massimizzare la qualità e le prestazioni della produzione Gestione dei materiali sostitutivi e di consumo: Gestione del materiale ottimizzata per una produzione liscia Gestione trasferimento di informazioni proattive: Resocontazione continua dei lavori effettuati per sostenere una pianificazione efficiente e l'implementazione Controllo qualità: Controllo sostenibile dei lavori di manutenzione e rilascio di impianti e processi mediante test funzionali e controllo dei processi statistici (SPC) per garantire i più elevati standard di produzione Formazione del personale: ulteriore formazione dei dipendenti nell'area tecnica per condividere le conoscenze e garantire la sicurezza dei processi Documentazione tecnica: Documentazione dei lavori di manutenzione e identificazione delle deviazioni nei documenti di manutenzione e di lavoro per migliorare la loro sicurezza di manutenzione: Compliance e monitoraggio delle linee guida per la sicurezza, la salute e la tutela dell'ambiente Questo si porta con formazione professionale completa EFZ o EBA nell'area tecnico-meccanica Esperienza nel campo della manutenzione, ideale Con noi, si può aspettare un posto di lavoro sicuro in una società orientata al futuro, emozionanti opportunità di sviluppo, un ambiente di lavoro collegiale e apprezzativo e benefici sociali attraenti.
descriptionByLocale.en: At our BiMOS Backend plant in Lenzburg, we manufacture efficient and high-quality power semiconductors for use in motor control systems and inverter systems. In this way, we make a decisive contribution to making industry, public and individual transport more energy efficient and, on the other hand, our technology enables the production and transport of renewable energies from the production site to the consumer. Become part of the energy transition and support us in maintaining and improving the availability of our production facilities. You can achieve this Planned Maintenance, Maintenance and Inspection: Regular and condition-dependent measures to avoid downtime and ensure plant availability carry out according to general specifications, specific maintenance instructions, documentation of deviations and planning of the management Calibration of plants and components: Ensuring the precise functionality of systems for maximizing production quality and performance Management of replacement and consumable materials: Optimized material management for a smooth production Management Proactive information transfer: Ongoing reporting of work carried out to support efficient planning and implementation Quality control: Sustainable inspection of the (self) carried out maintenance work as well as plant and process releases by means of functional tests and statistical process control (SPC) to ensure the highest production standards Training of the staff: further training of the employees in the technical area to share knowledge and ensure process safety Technical documentation: Documentation of the carried out maintenance work and identification of deviations in maintenance and work documents to improve their maintenance safety: Compliance and monitoring of safety, health and environmental protection guidelines to ensure a safe working environment This you bring with completed vocational training EFZ or EBA in the technical-mechanical area Experience in the field of maintenance, ideal With us, you can expect a secure workplace in a future-oriented company, exciting development opportunities, a collegial and appreciative working environment and attractive social benefits.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Dans notre usine de Lenzburg, nous fabriquons des semi-conducteurs de puissance efficaces et de haute qualité pour des systèmes de commande de moteurs et d'onduleurs. De cette manière, nous contribuons de manière décisive à rendre l'industrie, les transports publics et individuels plus économes en énergie et, d'autre part, notre technologie permet la production et le transport des énergies renouvelables du site de production au consommateur. Participez à la transition énergétique et aidez-nous à maintenir et à améliorer la disponibilité de nos installations de production. Vous pouvez réaliser ce plan d'entretien, d'entretien et d'inspection : Mesures régulières et dépendantes des conditions pour éviter les temps d'arrêt et assurer la disponibilité de l'usine effectuer selon les spécifications générales, les instructions d'entretien spécifiques, la documentation des écarts et la planification de la gestion Étalonnage des installations et des composants : Assurer la fonctionnalité précise des systèmes pour maximiser la qualité et les performances de production Gestion des matériaux de remplacement et consommables : Gestion optimisée des matériaux pour une production fluide Gestion Transfert d'information proactive : Rapports continus sur les travaux effectués pour appuyer une planification et une mise en oeuvre efficaces Contrôle de la qualité : inspection durable de l'auto-entretien ainsi que des rejets d'usines et de procédés au moyen d'essais fonctionnels et d'un contrôle statistique des procédés (SPC) pour assurer les normes de production les plus élevées Formation du personnel : formation continue des employés dans le domaine technique pour partager les connaissances et assurer la sécurité des procédés Documentation technique : Documentation des travaux d'entretien et identification des écarts dans les documents d'entretien et de travail pour améliorer leur sécurité d'entretien: Respect et surveillance des lignes directrices en matière de sécurité, de santé et de protection de l'environnement pour assurer un environnement de travail sûr Ce que vous apportez avec la formation professionnelle complète EFZ ou EBA dans le domaine technique-mécanique Expérience dans le domaine de l'entretien, idéal Avec nous, vous pouvez vous attendre à un lieu de travail sécurisé dans une entreprise orientée vers l'avenir, des opportunités de développement passionnant, un environnement de travail collégial et appréciateur et des avantages sociaux attrayants.

jobs.title: Corporate Real Estate Portfolio Analyst
jobs.description:
The opportunity We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Corporate Real Estate Portfolio Analyst to support the effective management of our global real estate portfolio. This role combines data management, lease management, reporting, and cross-functional coordination to ensure that portfolio decisions are supported by accurate information and meaningful insights. The ideal candidate brings experience in corporate real estate, real estate data management, lease management, Excel-based analysis, collaboration tools such as Teams and SharePoint, and the preparation of high-quality presentations for business stakeholders. 
• We offer flexible working arrangements, including the possibility to work in a hybrid model, combining remote work with time spent in the office. How you'll make an impact Manage and continuously improve portfolio data in Archibus, including property, lease, strategic planning, and sustainability-related information Develop strong expertise in Archibus functionalities and promote their effective use across the team. Deliver Archibus training and provide support to internal users Work closely with internal stakeholders to collect, validate, and consolidate portfolio data in a timely and reliable manner Oversee our external vendor responsible for lease administration and ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of lease data Identify and improve processes related to data collection, validation, lease abstraction, and lease management to enhance efficiency and control. Raise purchase orders and verify invoices Prepare presentation materials, analysis, reports, and charts using multiple data sources and tools Translate complex real estate data into clear insights that support portfolio decisions and management reporting Organize and maintain Teams and SharePoint sites and support the development of the division's intranet presence Contribute to the smooth and efficient operation of the Global Portfolio Management division through administrative support activities Your background Proven experience in real estate data management, analysis, and reporting. Experience in lease management. Experience in corporate real estate within a corporate global real estate function. Ability to interpret lease terms, understand portfolio structures and real estate data. Hands-on experience with a real estate data management platform. Excellent proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and SharePoint. Knowledge of SAP REFX is an asset. Strong analytical thinking, creativity, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Highly organized, rigorous, detail-oriented, and able to work with accuracy in a fast-evolving environment. Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and work effectively across different topics. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate successfully in a global team environment. More about us Hitachi Energy Real Estate provides strategic leadership for global real estate activities, acting as a business partner to improve performance through effective solutions. The Global Portfolio Management division shapes strategy, mitigates risks, and uses data-driven insights to enhance portfolio performance. It also supports real estate sustainability topics in collaboration with Business Units and Hitachi Energy Sustainability teams. The minimum salary for this position in the location (Italy) specified: Starting from: 44,800 € gross annual salary  Applicable CBA: Metalmeccanico The final offer will be based on candidate location, skills and qualifications, experience, and aligned with internal pay structures. This role is open in France, Germany, Switzerland, Italy and Spain. If the salary information listed is not applicable for your current home location, salary details relevant to your location will be discussed with you at a later stage. Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally includes: Competitive sa

jobs.title: Tender and Quotation Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is a global technology leader in the design and manufacture of high-voltage transformer bushings. Renowned international companies across the electrical industry—including power generation, transmission, and distribution—trust our solutions. We hold a leading worldwide position in high-voltage bushing technology. To strengthen our operations, we are looking for a Tender and Quotation Specialist to join out team at our MICAFIL bushing factory in Switzerland.  In this role, you will be part of an international team focusing on translating customer needs and challenges into competitive bids and quotations. You'll work closely with our sales and other internal teams to ensure that we offer the best solutions to meet our customers' needs around the globe. If you are passionate about preparing tenders and bids and want to actively contribute, join our team! How you'll make an impact Analyze Request for Quotations (RFQs), and other tender documents to understand client requirements, scope of work, and technical specifications with alignment with the Sales team Collaborate with sales, engineering, legal, and other internal departments to gather necessary information, technical details, and cost estimates for tender submissions Develop comprehensive and well-structured tender and quotation documents, including technical proposals, drawings, commercial offers and supporting documentation Ensure all submissions are accurate, complete, and meet the specified deadlines and submission protocols May participate in pre-bid meetings, client clarifications, and negotiations as required Maintain a systematic record of all tender activities, submissions, and outcomes, for quotations and order checklists preparation and handover Continuously improve tender processes and documentation templates to enhance efficiency and quality Coordinate with internal stakeholders for optimal solutions. Proactively maintain clear and structured communication with customers and the internal teams throughout the tendering process Your background Technical or commercial education background Minimum of 3 years of experience in tender management, quotation preparation and price calculation, or bid coordination, internal sales support, or project management within an industrial or technical environment Proven experience in formulating accurate bids and quotations Strong understanding of tender processes, contractual terms, and commercial aspects Excellent written and verbal communication skills Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and experience with tender management software or CRM systems Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to details and solution-driven approach Fluency in English is required; proficiency in German and other languages is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Il nostro gruppo di prodotti locale Insulation & Components è un leader tecnologico globale nella progettazione e produzione di boccole per trasformatori ad alta tensione. Rinomate aziende internazionali in tutto l'industria elettrica, tra cui produzione di energia, trasmissione e distribuzione, affidano le nostre soluzioni. Abbiamo una posizione leader a livello mondiale nella tecnologia Bushing ad alta tensione. Per rafforzare le nostre operazioni, stiamo cercando uno specialista Tender e Quotation per unirsi al nostro team di MICAFIL in Svizzera. In questo ruolo, sarete parte di un team internazionale che si concentra sulla traduzione delle esigenze e delle sfide dei clienti in offerte e citazioni competitive. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con le nostre vendite e altri team interni per garantire che offriamo le migliori soluzioni per soddisfare le esigenze dei nostri clienti in tutto il mondo. Se siete appassionati di preparare offerte e offerte e volete contribuire attivamente, unisciti al nostro team! Analizzare la richiesta di preventivi (RFQ) e altri documenti d'appalto per comprendere i requisiti del cliente, l'ambito del lavoro e le specifiche tecniche con allineamento con il team di vendita Collaborare con le attività di vendita, ingegneria, legale e altri dipartimenti interni per raccogliere informazioni necessarie, dettagli tecnici e stime dei costi per le presentazioni di gara Sviluppare documenti di gara e quotazione completi, comprese le proposte tecniche, disegni, offerte commerciali e documentazione di supporto Proattivamente mantenere una comunicazione chiara e strutturata con i clienti e le squadre interne durante il processo di appalto Minimo di 3 anni di esperienza nella gestione delle offerte, preparazione delle quote e calcolo dei prezzi, o coordinamento delle offerte, supporto delle vendite interne, o gestione del progetto all'interno di un ambiente industriale o tecnico Esperienza comprovata nella formulazione di offerte e citazioni accurate Forte comprensione dei processi teneri, dei termini contrattuali e degli aspetti commerciali Eccellente approccio scritto e verbale
descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is a global technology leader in the design and manufacture of high-voltage transformer bushings. Renowned international companies across the electrical industry—including power generation, transmission, and distribution—trust our solutions. We hold a leading worldwide position in high-voltage bushing technology. To strengthen our operations, we are looking for a Tender and Quotation Specialist to join out team at our MICAFIL bushing factory in Switzerland. In this role, you will be part of an international team focusing on translating customer needs and challenges into competitive bids and quotations. You'll work closely with our sales and other internal teams to ensure that we offer the best solutions to meet our customers' needs around the globe. If you are passionate about preparing tenders and bids and want to actively contribute, join our team! How you'll make an impact Analyze Request for Quotations (RFQs), and other tender documents to understand client requirements, scope of work, and technical specifications with alignment with the Sales team Collaborate with sales, engineering, legal, and other internal departments to gather necessary information, technical details, and cost estimates for tender submissions Develop comprehensive and well-structured tender and quotation documents, including technical proposals, drawings, commercial offers and supporting documentation Ensure all submissions are accurate, complete, and meet the specified deadlines and submission protocols May participate in pre-bid meetings, client clarifications, and negotiations as required Maintain a systematic record of all tender activities, submissions, and outcomes, for quotations and order checklists preparation and handover Continuously improve tender processes and documentation templates to enhance efficiency and quality Coordinate with internal stakeholders for optimal solutions. Proactively maintain clear and structured communication with customers and the internal teams throughout the tendering process Your background Technical or commercial education background Minimum of 3 years of experience in tender management, quotation preparation and price calculation, or bid coordination, internal sales support, or project management within an industrial or technical environment Proven experience in formulating accurate bids and quotations Strong understanding of tender processes, contractual terms, and commercial aspects Excellent written and verbal communication skills Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and experience with tender management software or CRM systems Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to details and solution-driven approach Fluency in English is required; proficiency in German and other languages is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Unsere lokale Produktgruppe Insulation & Components ist ein weltweiter Technologieführer in der Entwicklung und Herstellung von Hochspannungstransformatordurchführungen. Um unsere Aktivitäten zu stärken, suchen wir einen Tender- und Angebotsspezialisten, der sich unserem Team in unserer MICAFIL-Buchsenfabrik in der Schweiz anschließt. In dieser Rolle werden Sie Teil eines internationalen Teams sein, das sich darauf konzentriert, Kundenbedürfnisse und -herausforderungen in wettbewerbsfähige Angebote und Angebote zu übersetzen. Sie arbeiten eng mit unserem Vertrieb und anderen internen Teams zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass wir die besten Lösungen anbieten, um die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden auf der ganzen Welt zu erfüllen. Wenn Sie sich leidenschaftlich für die Vorbereitung von Ausschreibungen und Geboten interessieren und aktiv beitragen möchten, treten Sie unserem Team bei! Proaktiv klare und strukturierte Kommunikation mit Kunden und den internen Teams während des gesamten Ausschreibungsprozesses Ihr Hintergrund Technische oder kaufmännische Ausbildung Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in Ausschreibungsmanagement, Angebotsvorbereitung und Preiskalkulation oder Gebotskoordination, interne Verkaufsunterstützung oder Projektmanagement in einem industriellen oder technischen Umfeld Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Formulierung genauer Gebote und Angebote Starkes Verständnis von Ausschreibungsprozessen, Vertragsbedingungen und kommerziellen Aspekten Ausgezeichnete schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) und Erfahrung mit Ausschreibungsmanagement-Software oder CRM-Systemen Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten, mit scharfer Aufmerksamkeit für Details und lösungsorientierter Ansatz Fluency in Englisch ist erforderlich; Kenntnisse in Deutsch und anderen Sprachen sind ein Plus Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Notre groupe de produits local Isolation & Components est un leader technologique mondial dans la conception et la fabrication de douilles de transformateurs haute tension. jobs.title: Application Engineering Line Manager - Power Conversion, Power Quality Industry, Grid Connection
jobs.description: The Opportunity As a manager and experienced Application Engineer for Power Conversion, Power Quality Industry and Grid Connection you will join a global team shaping the future of reliable, stable, and high ‑ quality power systems. You will work closely with customers and consultants to understand their challenges, guide them early in the process, and design solutions that help them reach their goals. As a dynamic manager, you have a strong drive in combination with customer focus, ability to gather information and convey technical conclusions to individuals in engineering, business, and related industry. You will have the opportunity to become a trusted technical partner—someone who listens deeply, sees the full picture, and translates complex needs into optimized, cost ‑ effective solutions. In this role, you will influence both the technology direction and the customer journey, while supporting growth in key segments and individuals aligned with our Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service (GPQSS) strategy. You will collaborate daily with colleagues across departments as you drive business development and pre ‑ tender engagement, shape technical strategies, and help customers navigate the future of grid and power quality solutions. This is a role where your expertise matters, your voice is heard, and your impact is felt across projects and markets. Experience from Power Conversion, Power Quality Industry or Grid Connection applications is required for the position, and you will have operational focus driving some of the business pursuits as Application Engineer. Part of the role will also be to build up competence to support market growth for Grid and Power Quality Solutions within the Application Engineering team. You will be part of management team in Application Engineering. This position is based in Västerås\/Solna, Sweden, Mannheim, Germany or Turgi, Switzerland. How you'll make an impact Lead and mentor a team of 4 GPG Application Engineers, and 14 additional HBU and GCoC Application Engineers spread across the world that will report to you functionally. Coordinate and plan business development and pre‑tender activities for Application Engineering Power Conversion, Power Quality Industry and Grid Connection team to optimize technology solution positioning Hitachi. Engage early with customers to understand needs and explore opportunities. Shape optimized, cost‑effective solutions across our Power Conversion, Power Quality Industry and Grid Connection portfolio. Represent Application Engineering in cross‑functional teams to ensure integration and stakeholder alignment. Build long‑term stakeholder relationships that support market growth Guide teams and coordinate complex technical inputs across the business development and sales cycle. Manage risks, issues, and changes, ensuring clear communication and mitigation strategies. Drive strategy, innovation and improve project processes, tools, and methodologies across the virtual Application Engineering community. Promote awareness of full GPQSS offerings and new technical solutions. Ensure all solutions follow process, safety and quality standards Your background Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics or similar Strong experience in application engineering, business development or lead engineering within the industry for Power Conversion, Power Quality Industry and Grid Connection solutions. descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità In qualità di manager e esperto Application Engineer for Power Conversion, Power Quality Industry e Grid Connection si unirà a un team globale che modella il futuro di sistemi di potenza affidabili, stabili e di alta qualità. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con clienti e consulenti per capire le loro sfide, guidarli presto nel processo e soluzioni di progettazione che li aiutano a raggiungere i loro obiettivi. Come manager dinamico, hai un forte impulso in combinazione con il focus del cliente, la capacità di raccogliere informazioni e trasmettere conclusioni tecniche a individui in ingegneria, business e settore relativo. Avrete l'opportunità di diventare un partner tecnico di fiducia, qualcuno che ascolta profondamente, vede il quadro completo, e traduce le esigenze complesse in soluzioni ottimizzate ed efficaci. In questo ruolo, influenzerai sia la direzione tecnologica che il percorso del cliente, supportando la crescita dei segmenti chiave e degli individui allineati alla nostra strategia Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service (GPQSS). Collaborerai quotidianamente con colleghi di tutti i dipartimenti, guidando lo sviluppo aziendale e il coinvolgimento pre- tenero, modellando le strategie tecniche e aiutando i clienti a navigare nel futuro delle soluzioni di griglia e qualità di potenza. Questo è un ruolo in cui la vostra esperienza conta, la vostra voce viene ascoltata, e il vostro impatto è sentito attraverso progetti e mercati. L'esperienza da Power Conversion, Power Quality Industry o Grid Connection è necessaria per la posizione, e si avrà un focus operativo che guida alcuni degli inseguimenti aziendali come Application Engineer. Parte del ruolo sarà anche quello di costruire competenze per supportare la crescita del mercato per le soluzioni Grid e Power Quality all'interno del team di Application Engineering. Sarete parte del team di gestione in Ingegneria delle applicazioni. Questa posizione si trova a Västerås\/Solna, Svezia, Mannheim, Germania o Turgi, Svizzera. Come farete un impatto Piombo e mentore un team di 4 GPG Application Engineers, e 14 ulteriori HBU e GCoC Application Engineers sparsi in tutto il mondo che vi riferiranno in modo funzionale. Coordinare e pianificare lo sviluppo aziendale e le attività pre-tender per Application Engineering Power Conversion, Power Quality Industry e Grid Connection team per ottimizzare la soluzione tecnologica posizionando Hitachi. Impegnarsi presto con i clienti per capire le esigenze e esplorare le opportunità. Soluzioni ottimizzate ed economicamente vantaggiose nel nostro portafoglio di connessione Power Conversion, Power Quality Industry e Grid Connection. Rappresenta l'Ingegnere delle applicazioni in team multifunzionali per garantire l'integrazione e l'allineamento delle parti interessate. Costruire relazioni di stakeholder a lungo termine che supportano la crescita del mercato Guide team e coordinare complessi input tecnici attraverso il ciclo di sviluppo e vendita aziendale. Gestisci rischi, problemi e cambiamenti, assicurando chiare strategie di comunicazione e mitigazione. Guidare la strategia, l'innovazione e migliorare i processi di progetto, gli strumenti e le metodologie in tutta la comunità virtuale di Application Engineering. Promuovere la consapevolezza delle offerte GPQSS complete e delle nuove soluzioni tecniche. Assicurarsi che tutte le soluzioni seguano standard di processo, sicurezza e qualità Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria Elettrica, Elettronica di Potere o simile Esperienza forte in ingegneria delle applicazioni, sviluppo aziendale o ingegneria di piombo all'interno del settore per le soluzioni di conversione di potenza, industria di qualità di potenza e connessione di rete. L'esperienza di HVDC Offshore Wind è un vantaggio. Esperienza nella guida di team, nel coordinamento di progetti complessi e nella promozione di una cultura ad alte prestazioni. Buona comprensione dei codici a griglia, il loro ruolo nell'infrastruttura del sistema di potenza e l'impatto del portafoglio GPQSS in trasformazione per la conformità alla stabilità, affidabilità e qualità delle griglie di potenza. Competenza tecnica in Grid and Power Quality Solutions e relativi strumenti di ingegneria (PSSE, PSCAD, RTDS, MATLAB, ecc.) Esperienza comprovata coinvolgendo i clienti e sviluppando partnership a lungo termine Eccellente comunicatore w

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité En tant que gestionnaire et ingénieur d'application expérimenté pour la conversion de puissance, l'industrie de la qualité de l'énergie et la connexion au réseau, vous rejoindrez une équipe mondiale qui façonnera l'avenir de systèmes d'alimentation fiables, stables et de haute qualité. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les clients et les consultants pour comprendre leurs défis, les guider au début du processus et concevoir des solutions qui les aident à atteindre leurs objectifs. En tant que gestionnaire dynamique, vous avez une dynamique forte en combinaison avec l'orientation client, la capacité de recueillir de l'information et de transmettre des conclusions techniques aux particuliers dans l'ingénierie, les affaires et l'industrie connexe. Vous aurez l'occasion de devenir un partenaire technique de confiance – quelqu'un qui écoute profondément, voit l'image complète et traduit des besoins complexes en solutions optimisées et rentables. Dans ce rôle, vous influencerez à la fois l'orientation technologique et le parcours client, tout en soutenant la croissance des segments clés et des individus alignés sur notre stratégie Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service (GPQSS). Vous collaborerez quotidiennement avec des collègues de tous les ministères pour stimuler le développement des entreprises et l'engagement avant l'appel d'offres, élaborer des stratégies techniques et aider les clients à naviguer dans l'avenir des solutions de qualité du réseau et de l'électricité. C'est un rôle qui compte pour votre expertise, votre voix est entendue, et votre impact se fait sentir dans les projets et les marchés. L'expérience des applications de conversion de puissance, d'industrie de la qualité de l'énergie ou de connexion au réseau est requise pour le poste, et vous aurez l'orientation opérationnelle conduisant certaines des activités commerciales en tant qu'ingénieur d'application. Une partie du rôle sera également de renforcer les compétences pour soutenir la croissance du marché pour Grid et Power Quality Solutions au sein de l'équipe Application Engineering. Vous ferez partie de l'équipe de gestion en Ingénierie des applications. Cette position est basée à Västerås\/Solna, Suède, Mannheim, Allemagne ou Turgy, Suisse.
