jobs.title: Research Scientist - Complex Systems Modelling for Reliability (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   At Hitachi Energy Research, we are shaping the energy systems of tomorrow. As the power grid evolves into a complex, digital “system of systems” integrating renewable energy, power electronics, and distributed assets, ensuring long-term reliability and availability becomes a central challenge. We are looking for a Scientist in Reliability Modelling to drive innovation in system-level reliability modelling and lifecycle optimization of power grid components and system, large-scale power grid infrastructures, including emerging application in challenging environments to help development of sustainable energy sources and their integration to the power grid of the future. How you'll make an impact   System-Level Reliability Modelling Innovation:  Drive the translation of innovative ideas advanced methodologies for reliability, availability, maintainability, and safety (RAMS) modelling integrating single-asset physical knowledge into modelling to represent interdependencies, redundancy, and system-of-systems behavior Data-driven and Physics based Decision Support:  Contribute to methodologies such as Reliability-Centered Maintenance and reliability twin concepts for decision-making under uncertainty with far reaching impact on GW level power systems over decades of operation Scientific Leadership  Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers across research and business units to identify, shape, and solve impactful industrial challenges Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities, technologies and products suppliers Scientific Communication & Innovation:  Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports    Your background    PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Reliability Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related field Systems thinker capable of bridging component-level physics and system-level performance. Strong expertise in system-level reliability modelling (RAMS, RBD, FTA, Monte Carlo, stochastic modelling) Experience with complex engineering systems (energy, aerospace, automotive, or similar high-reliability domains). Including knowledge of maintenance strategies and lifecycle optimization for repairable systems Familiarity with power grid technologies (HVDC, substations, converters) is an advantage but not strictly required Proven track record at top scientific conferences and journal publications Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity More about us   At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every individual. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Join us in shaping a more sustainable and reliable energy future.

jobs.title: CDSe Domain Expert – Liquid and Dry Transformers
jobs.description: The Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals, and factories. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact to our communities and society. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and be part of a global team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation. We are currently seeking a skilled and highly motivated candidate to join our CDSe (Common Design System Electrical) team as a CDSe Domain Expert for Liquid and Dry Transformers. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in the development and enhancement of the distribution transformer electrical design platform , ensuring it meets the highest standards of performance, reliability, and efficiency. How You'll Make An Impact Support CDSe development and maintenance by aligning with technical standards and technological advancements. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, design solutions, and implement new features. Prepare software specifications, collaborate with developers on implementation, and verify the accuracy of implemented features.Develop test cases to ensure the sustainable quality of the CDS platform and lead test sessions with end users. Conduct thorough testing and validation of the design platform to ensure accuracy and reliability.Perform comparative analysis of calculated and tested transformer parameters, identify root causes of discrepancies, and propose effective solutions. Provide technical support, prepare training materials, and deliver training sessions to end users.Monitor hotline requests and act on user feedback to improve the platform's performance.Work closely with Hub Engineering teams to accelerate CDS implementation in factories. Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies and incorporate them into the platform. Be part of a multicultural, globally distributed CDS community and propose innovative solutions. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external & internal regulations, procedures & guidelines. Your Background  Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. Proven experience in the design of dry-type or liquid transformers. Strong knowledge of design principles, materials, manufacturing, and testing of transformers.Awareness of different transformer technologies. Experience in or interest in software development (e.g., macro development, Excel automation tools). Proactive, self-motivated, with a strong sense of ownership.Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills & Ability to work independently as well as within a multidisciplinary team. Strong communication skills, with good verbal and written English proficiency. More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefit programs to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us in work and out.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, il nostro scopo sta avanzando un futuro energetico sostenibile per tutti. Portiamo il potere nelle nostre case, scuole, ospedali e fabbriche. Unisciti a noi e lavorare con persone fantastiche, imparando e sviluppandosi su progetti che hanno un impatto reale per le nostre comunità e la società. Porta la tua passione, porta la tua energia e fai parte di un team globale che apprezza una semplice verità: diversità + collaborazione = grande innovazione. Siamo attualmente alla ricerca di un candidato qualificato e altamente motivato per aderire al nostro team CDSe (Common Design System Electric) come esperto di dominio CDSe per trasformatori liquidi e a secco. Il candidato di successo svolgerà un ruolo cruciale nello sviluppo e nella valorizzazione della piattaforma di progettazione elettrica del trasformatore di distribuzione, assicurando che soddisfi i più elevati standard di prestazioni, affidabilità ed efficienza. Come farete un supporto d'impatto sviluppo e manutenzione CDSe allineando con standard tecnici e progressi tecnologici. Collabora con team interfunzionali per raccogliere requisiti, soluzioni di progettazione e implementare nuove funzionalità. Preparare le specifiche del software, collaborare con gli sviluppatori sull'implementazione e verificare l'accuratezza delle funzionalità implementate. Sviluppare casi di test per garantire la qualità sostenibile della piattaforma CDS e sessioni di test con gli utenti finali. Condurre test approfonditi e validazione della piattaforma di progettazione per garantire precisione e affidabilità. Eseguire l'analisi comparativa dei parametri di trasformatore calcolati e testati, identificare le cause di root delle discrepanze e proporre soluzioni efficaci. Fornire supporto tecnico, preparare materiali di formazione e fornire sessioni di formazione per gli utenti finali. Monitorare le richieste di hotline e agire sul feedback degli utenti per migliorare le prestazioni della piattaforma. Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di Hub Engineering per accelerare l'implementazione di CDS nelle fabbriche. Resta aggiornato sulle tendenze del settore e sulle tecnologie emergenti e incorporale nella piattaforma. Partecipa a una comunità di CDS multiculturale e distribuita a livello mondiale e propone soluzioni innovative. Responsabile per garantire il rispetto delle normative esterne e interne applicabili, procedure e linee guida. La tua laurea di primo livello o master in ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica, o un campo correlato. Provata esperienza nella progettazione di trasformatori a secco o liquido. Forte conoscenza dei principi di progettazione, materiali, produzione e test dei trasformatori. Consapevolezza delle diverse tecnologie del trasformatore. Esperienza o interesse nello sviluppo del software (ad esempio, sviluppo macro, strumenti di automazione di Excel). Proattivo, automotivato, con un forte senso di proprietà. Eccellente analitica e problem solving competenze & Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e all'interno di un team multidisciplinare. Forte capacità di comunicazione, con buona padronanza inglese verbale e scritta. Siamo orgogliosi di offrire una gamma olistica di programmi di beneficio competitivo per sostenere il vostro benessere finanziario, fisico e mentale e lo sviluppo personale. Vogliamo che tu prosperi veramente con noi nel lavoro e fuori.

How you'll make an impact Develop new packaging technologies for power electronics (PE) modules to enable higher current capability, sustain higher temperatures and stresses under harsh environmental conditions Support the build-up and characterization of prototypes of IGBT modules for quality assessment using several techniques such as scanning acoustic microscopy, cross-sections, electrical and reliability testing Conduct design of experiments (DoEs) to support technology development through process and materials optimization Interact and collaborate with a dynamic and multidisciplinary team that will supervise and guide the project Use your strong technical background, motivation to develop innovative solutions, and goal-oriented approach to make a significant impact on the project Your background Currently pursuing a degree in material sciences, mechanical engineering, chemistry, physics, or similar discipline (B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree internship and\/or thesis) Experience in laboratory work and know-how in sample preparation and material characterization techniques Know-how in data analysis tools and statistics is advantageous Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to think creatively and independently to resolve technical challenges Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively document the design and present results to the team Fluent in written ans spoken English A self-starter with a strong work ethic and the ability to work independently or as part of a team Willingness to learn new concepts and technologies related to semiconductor packaging More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. jobs.title: Scientist in AI-Driven Power Electronics (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Empower the Future with Hitachi Energy: Join us as Scientist in AI-Driven Power Electronics We are looking for a research scientist with expertise in power electronics and power grid applications to join our Research Center in Baden\/Switzerland. In an interdisciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation and develop new solutions for a wide range of fast-growing applications like HVDC, energy storage systems and renewables like wind or solar. Seize this unique opportunity and join our motivated team to contribute to a sustainable energy future for all!  How you'll make an impact   You innovate: Transform power electronics modeling, design and optimization by incorporating AI and ML You investigate: Perform industrial research in multi-physics modelling and optimization for power electronic systems to create advanced, high-efficiency engineering tools targeting new solutions for power grid applications. You take initiative: Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers across research and business units to identify, shape, and solve impactful industrial challenges You collaborate: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities and vendors You communicate: Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports    Your background  PhD in Electrical Engineering specialized in Power Electronics or PhD in Computer Science specialized in AI Proven expertise in AI\/ML, with a solid understanding of algorithms, frameworks, and extensive experience in Python and relevant software tools Ability to apply AI\/ML to engineering problems, in particular in the field of power electronics Experience in power electronics design and modeling. Know-how in power electronics integration topics such as cooling and mechanical integration, insulation, EMC, and grid integration is considered as a plus Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity More about us   At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Emettere il futuro con Hitachi Energy: Unisciti a noi come scienziato in AI-Driven Power Electronics
• Stiamo cercando uno scienziato di ricerca con esperienza nell'elettronica di potenza e nelle applicazioni di rete elettrica per unire il nostro Centro di Ricerca in Baden\/Svizzera. In un ambiente interdisciplinare, guiderai l'innovazione all'avanguardia e svilupperai nuove soluzioni per una vasta gamma di applicazioni in rapida crescita come HVDC, sistemi di storage energetico e rinnovabili come il vento o il solare. Cogliete questa opportunità unica e unitevi al nostro team motivato per contribuire a un futuro energetico sostenibile per tutti! Innovare: Trasformare la modellazione, il design e l'ottimizzazione dell'elettronica di potenza incorporando AI e ML Si indaga: Eseguire la ricerca industriale nella modellazione multi-fisica e l'ottimizzazione per i sistemi elettronici di potenza per creare strumenti di ingegneria avanzati e ad alta efficienza che mirano a nuove soluzioni per le applicazioni della rete elettrica. Si prende l'iniziativa: collaborare con un team globale e interdisciplinare di ricercatori e ingegneri attraverso le unità di ricerca e di business per identificare, modellare e risolvere sfide industriali impellenti Collabori: Costruisci relazioni all'interno dell'azienda e condividi attivamente le tue conoscenze e competenze. Interagire con partner esterni locali e globali, tra cui università e fornitori Voi comunicate: Disseminate i vostri risultati in pubblicazioni scientifiche, domande di brevetti e rapporti tecnici Il vostro dottorato di ricerca in Ingegneria Elettrica specializzato in Elettronica di Potere o PhD in Informatica specializzata nella competenza AI Proven in AI\/ML, con una solida comprensione di algoritmi, quadri, e una vasta esperienza in Python e strumenti software rilevanti Capacità di applicare AI\/ML a problemi di ingegneria, in particolare nel campo dell'elettronica di potenza Esperienza nella progettazione e modellazione elettronica. Il know-how nell'integrazione dell'elettronica di potenza, come il raffreddamento e l'integrazione meccanica, l'isolamento, l'EMC e l'integrazione della rete è considerato come una capacità di comunicazione più eccellente in inglese, atteggiamento del giocatore di squadra, iniziativa e creatività. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo dove tutti possano prosperare. Vi invitiamo a candidarvi e unirvi a noi nella definizione di un futuro sostenibile.

descriptionByLocale.de: Befähigen Sie die Zukunft mit Hitachi Energy: Begleiten Sie uns als Wissenschaftler in AI-Driven Power Electronics Wir suchen einen Forscher mit Expertise in Leistungselektronik und Stromnetzanwendungen, der unserem Forschungszentrum in Baden/Schweiz beitritt. In einem interdisziplinären Umfeld treiben Sie Innovationen voran und entwickeln neue Lösungen für eine Vielzahl schnell wachsender Anwendungen wie HGÜ, Energiespeichersysteme und erneuerbare Energien wie Wind oder Sonne. Know-how in Leistungselektronik Integration Themen wie Kühlung und mechanische Integration, Isolierung, EMV und Netzintegration wird als plus ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch, Teamplayer Haltung, Initiative und Kreativität angesehen Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy glauben wir an die Kraft der Vielfalt und das Potenzial jeder Person. descriptionByLocale.fr: Empower the Future with Hitachi Energy: Joignez-vous à nous en tant que scientifique dans l'électronique assistée par l'IA Nous recherchons un chercheur spécialisé dans l'électronique électrique et les applications du réseau électrique pour rejoindre notre centre de recherche à Baden\/Suisse. Dans un environnement interdisciplinaire, vous stimulerez l'innovation de pointe et développerez de nouvelles solutions pour une large gamme d'applications à croissance rapide comme HVDC, les systèmes de stockage d'énergie et les énergies renouvelables comme l'éolien ou l'énergie solaire. Vous prenez l'initiative : Collaborez avec une équipe mondiale et interdisciplinaire de chercheurs et d'ingénieurs à travers les unités de recherche et d'affaires pour identifier, façonner et résoudre les défis industriels pertinents Vous collaborez : établir des relations au sein de l'entreprise et partager activement vos connaissances et votre expertise. Interagir avec les partenaires extérieurs locaux et mondiaux, y compris les universités et les fournisseurs Vous communiquez : Diffusez vos résultats dans des publications scientifiques, des demandes de brevet et des rapports techniques Votre doctorat en génie électrique spécialisé en électronique de puissance ou un doctorat en informatique spécialisé en AI Expertise éprouvée en AI\/ML, avec une solide compréhension des algorithmes, des cadres et une vaste expérience en Python et outils logiciels pertinents Capacité d'appliquer l'IA\/ML aux problèmes d'ingénierie, en particulier dans le domaine de l'électronique de puissance Expérience en conception et modélisation de l'électronique de puissance. Le savoir-faire en matière d'intégration électronique de puissance comme le refroidissement et l'intégration mécanique, l'isolation, l'EMC et l'intégration du réseau est considéré comme un plus Excellente capacité de communication en anglais, attitude des joueurs d'équipe, initiative et créativité Plus sur nous Chez Hitachi Energy, nous croyons en la puissance de la diversité et le potentiel de chaque personne. Nous sommes déterminés à créer un environnement inclusif où chacun puisse prospérer. Nous vous invitons à postuler et à nous rejoindre pour façonner un avenir durable.

jobs.title: Project Technician Electrical Engineering 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Products business and become part of a globally recognized team delivering advanced solutions for power transmission and distribution. In this role, you will support the development and execution of customer-specific projects for Generator Circuit-Breakers used in power generation applications worldwide. Based in Zurich-Oerlikon, you will combine your electrical engineering expertise with your Mandarin Chinese language skills to support customers and business partners in China and contribute to the global energy transition. How you'll make an impact Create customer-specific wiring and electrical schematics based on technical requirements and project specifications Develop and maintain wiring diagrams for new products and product enhancements using EPLAN P8 Revise electrical documentation to reflect customer requirements, control system changes, and product developments Provide technical support to suppliers involved in control cabinet manufacturing and assembly Maintain and further develop component and language databases within EPLAN P8 Collaborate closely with project managers, engineering teams, suppliers, and international customers Support project execution through occasional travel to customer sites and power plants, mainly in China Ensure compliance with internal procedures, industry standards, safety regulations, and quality requirements Your background Completed apprenticeship, technical diploma, or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in electrical design, engineering, or a comparable technical role Experience with EPLAN P8 or similar ECAD software is an advantage Fluent in Mandarin and English; German language skills are an advantage Strong attention to detail and a structured, precise way of working Independent, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset Team player with strong communication and collaboration skills Willingness to travel internationally as required by projects, approximately 20% More about us Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Products business is a global leader in power transmission and distribution technologies. Within this business, our Generator Circuit-Breaker team develops, manufactures, markets, and services high-current switching systems for power plants around the world. 
• We offer an inclusive and collaborative work environment, flexible working models, and exciting opportunities for professional growth. Join us and help shape a more sustainable energy future for generations to come.

descriptionByLocale.fr:

Basé à Zurich-Oerlikon, vous combinerez votre expertise en génie électrique avec vos compétences en mandarin chinois pour soutenir les clients et les partenaires commerciaux en Chine et contribuer à la transition énergétique mondiale. jobs.title: Bid Specialist 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity At Hitachi Energy our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals and factories. Joining our collaborative and diverse team, you'll help shape next generation designs that improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability in critical power applications. As a Bid Specialist you create preliminary design cost estimations for dry type transformers plus inductors according to customer specifications. A secondary objective is to provide sales and customers with technical support and act as a link between sales and engineering. Apply today! 
• Your responsibilities Review customer specifications to define technical tender requirements Develop preliminary design of the product Prepare a technical sheet and propose suitable technical solutions to be integrated in the proposal documentation Create accurate cost estimates and define material requirements in ERP  Obtain accurate pricing information by collaborating with suppliers & vendors Ensure on-time cost estimate submittal to the bid and proposal team Maintaining accurate technical and costing product information throughout the entire deal lifecycle Provide technical tender support during bid revision or negotiation Ensure clear and timely communication with all tender stakeholders Your background University Degree in Electrical or Mechanical engineering, or similar vocational education (high school – perito elettrotecnico, apprentice – apprendistato\/istituto tecnico industriale) First experience in a similar role, especially considering the technical skills is an advantage Experience in Microsoft 365 tools, preferably, knowledge of SAP, CAD and AI Strong attention to detail and communication skills as well as a self-starter mentality Fluent in English, Italian would be beneficial Willingness to travel up to 10% on short trips More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Global AI Prompting Engineer PGTR
jobs.description: The opportunity As part of our ongoing digital transformation journey, we are developing ACE, a cutting-edge Generative AI-powered platform designed to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of our Bid & Proposal Management process within the Transformers Business Unit. We are seeking a Prompt Engineer who will play a pivotal role in this initiative. This individual will be responsible for designing, testing, and optimizing domain-specific prompts that enable ACE to generate accurate, context-aware, and business-aligned outputs. The role requires a deep understanding of transformer industry, industrial equipment standards as well as basic understanding of prompt engineering best practices and GenAI model behavior, ensuring that ACE delivers high-quality responses tailored to complex business scenarios. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with IT Experts, Subject Matter Experts, Business stakeholders, and Module Owners to break down complex business logic into domain-specific prompts. How you'll make an impact Develop, refine, and maintain prompt libraries for various transformer units\/factories. Implement advanced techniques like prompt chaining, context injection, and few-shot learning for enterprise-grade accuracy. Own prompt lifecycle management including versioning, traceability, and governance. Evaluate LLM responses for precision, compliance, and bias mitigation. Conduct A\/B testing and maintain performance dashboards for prompt effectiveness. Work closely with Module Owners, Subject Matter Experts, and Business Stakeholders to embed prompts into ACE workflows. Create clear documentation for prompt strategies and maintain best practices aligned with Hitachi Energy's AI Ethics Charter. Stay updated on emerging GenAI technologies, frameworks, and tools to enhance ACE capabilities. Implement and recommend best practices for prompting across different ACE modules. Your background Bachelor or master degree in electrical engineering Experience working in the transformer industry, with international standards and customer documentation. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking. Strong linguistic and logical reasoning for crafting precise prompts. Strong understanding of NLP, context management, and token optimization. Ability to experiment and iterate to optimize outputs. Ability to understand business processes and translate them into ACE-specific prompts. Hands-on experience with LLMs and prompt engineering techniques. Strong interest in AI enterprise-grade solutions. Willingness to learn Python and experience with AI APIs services. Ability to work in Agile environments and manage multiple stakeholders. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Analytical mindset with attention to detail. Empathy for end users and curiosity for experimentation. Commitment to ethical AI practices and continuous learning. Reduction in prompt failure rate and model hallucination. Improvement in accuracy of outputs by modules. Speed and scalability of prompt deployment across ACE modules within the Transformer Business Unit. Compliance with AI governance and security standards. More about us At Hitachi Energy, we recognize that our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to providing a supportive and inclusive workplace, competitive rewards, and opportunities for professional and personal growth. Our benefits package is designed to help employees thrive both at work and in their personal lives. Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally includes:​ Competitive salary and incentives​ Well-being and care ​ Paid and unpaid leave​ Flexible work options ​ Benefits that support your financial security​ You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità Nell'ambito del nostro continuo viaggio di trasformazione digitale, stiamo sviluppando ACE, una piattaforma generativa AI all'avanguardia progettata per migliorare l'efficienza e l'accuratezza del nostro processo di Bid & Propost Management all'interno della Transformers Business Unit.
• Stiamo cercando un Prompt Engineer che svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale in questa iniziativa. Questo individuo sarà responsabile per la progettazione, il test e l'ottimizzazione dei prompt specifici di dominio che consentono ACE di generare output accurati, contestuali e business-aligned. Il ruolo richiede una profonda comprensione dell'industria dei trasformatori, degli standard di attrezzature industriali e della comprensione di base delle migliori pratiche ingegneristiche e del comportamento del modello GenAI, assicurando che ACE offre risposte di alta qualità su misura per scenari aziendali complessi. Il candidato ideale lavorerà a stretto contatto con gli esperti IT, gli esperti di materia principale, le parti interessate di business e i proprietari di moduli per abbattere la logica aziendale complessa in richieste specifiche per il dominio. Come farete un impatto Sviluppare, perfezionare e mantenere librerie rapide per varie unità di trasformatori\/fattori. Implementare tecniche avanzate come la catena rapida, l'iniezione di contesto, e l'apprendimento di pochi colpi per la precisione di livello enterprise. Gestione del proprio ciclo di vita rapido tra cui la versione, tracciabilità e governance. Valuta le risposte LLM per la precisione, la conformità e la mitigazione dei pregiudizi. Condurre test A\/B e mantenere le dashboard delle prestazioni per una rapida efficacia. Lavorare a stretto contatto con i proprietari di moduli, gli esperti di materia principale del soggetto e gli stakeholder aziendali per incorporare i suggerimenti nei flussi di lavoro ACE. Creare una documentazione chiara per le strategie rapide e mantenere le migliori pratiche allineate con la Carta Etica AI di Hitachi Energy. Resta aggiornato sulle tecnologie, i framework e gli strumenti emergenti di GenAI per migliorare le capacità ACE. Implementare e consigliare le migliori pratiche per richiedere diversi moduli ACE. Corso di laurea o master in ingegneria elettrica Esperienza di lavoro nell'industria del trasformatore, con gli standard internazionali e la documentazione del cliente. Forte problem-solving e pensiero analitico. Forte ragionamento linguistico e logico per la realizzazione di precisi suggerimenti. Forte comprensione di NLP, gestione del contesto e ottimizzazione dei token. Capacità di sperimentare e iterare per ottimizzare gli output. Capacità di comprendere i processi aziendali e tradurli in richieste specifiche ACE. Esperienza pratica con LLM e tecniche ingegneristiche rapide. Forte interesse per le soluzioni aziendali AI. Volontà di imparare Python ed esperienza con i servizi AI APIs. Capacità di lavorare in ambienti Agile e gestire più stakeholder. Ottima capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione. Mindset analitico con attenzione ai dettagli. Empatia per gli utenti finali e curiosità per la sperimentazione. Impegno alle pratiche etiche dell'IA e all'apprendimento continuo. Riduzione del tasso di guasto rapido e allucinazione del modello. Miglioramento della precisione delle uscite per moduli. Velocità e scalabilità dell'implementazione rapida tra i moduli ACE all'interno del Transformer Business Unit. Rispetto degli standard di governance e sicurezza AI. A Hitachi Energy, riconosciamo che il nostro popolo è al centro del nostro successo. Ci impegniamo a fornire un lavoro di supporto e inclusivo, premi competitivi e opportunità di crescita professionale e personale. Il nostro pacchetto benefici è progettato per aiutare i dipendenti a prosperare sia al lavoro che nella loro vita personale. La nostra offerta di benefici è su misura in base al vostro paese di lavoro e in genere include: Competitività e incentivi Benessere e cura congedo pagato e non pagato Opzioni di lavoro flessibili Vantaggi che supportano la sicurezza finanziaria Riceverai informazioni più specifiche durante il processo di reclutamento.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Im Rahmen unserer laufenden digitalen Transformation entwickeln wir ACE, eine hochmoderne Generative AI-basierte Plattform, die die Effizienz und Genauigkeit unseres Bid & Proposal Management-Prozesses innerhalb der Transformers Business Unit verbessern soll. Wir suchen einen Prompt Engineer, der eine zentrale Rolle in dieser Initiative spielen wird. Diese Person wird für das Entwerfen, Testen und Optimieren domänenspezifischer Eingabeaufforderungen verantwortlich sein, die es ACE ermöglichen, genaue, kontextbezogene und geschäftsorientierte Ergebnisse zu generieren. Die Rolle erfordert ein tiefes Verständnis der Transformatorenindustrie, Industrieausrüstungsstandards sowie ein grundlegendes Verständnis der prompten technischen Best Practices und des GenAI-Modellverhaltens, um sicherzustellen, dass ACE qualitativ hochwertige Antworten liefert, die auf komplexe Geschäftsszenarien zugeschnitten sind. Der ideale Kandidat wird eng mit IT-Experten, Subject Matter Experts, Business Stakeholdern und Modulbesitzern zusammenarbeiten, um komplexe Geschäftslogik in domänenspezifische Eingabeaufforderungen zu zerlegen. Wie Sie Einfluss haben Entwickeln, verfeinern und pflegen Sie prompte Bibliotheken für verschiedene Transformatoreinheiten / Fabriken. Implementieren Sie fortschrittliche Techniken wie prompte Verkettung, Kontextinjektion und Little-Shot-Learning für Genauigkeit auf Unternehmensebene. Eigenes promptes Lifecycle-Management einschließlich Versionierung, Rückverfolgbarkeit und Governance. Bewerten Sie LLM-Antworten auf Präzision, Compliance und Bias-Abschwächung. Führen Sie A\/B-Tests durch und pflegen Sie Performance-Dashboards für eine sofortige Effektivität. Arbeiten Sie eng mit Modulbesitzern, Fachexperten und Geschäftsinteressenten zusammen, um Eingabeaufforderungen in ACE-Workflows einzubetten. Erstellen Sie eine klare Dokumentation für schnelle Strategien und pflegen Sie Best Practices, die mit der KI-Ethikcharta von Hitachi Energy in Einklang stehen. Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden über neue GenAI-Technologien, Frameworks und Tools, um die ACE-Fähigkeiten zu verbessern. Implementieren und empfehlen Sie Best Practices für Aufforderungen in verschiedenen ACE-Modulen. Comment vous ferez la différence
- Diriger et coordonner des projets internes axés sur l'optimisation des produits et des processus dans le segment des bushings haute tension
- Analyser les conceptions existantes et les processus de fabrication en mettant l'accent sur l'efficacité, la qualité et les coûts
- Identifier les axes d'amélioration et mettre en œuvre les mesures correspondantes
- Collaborer étroitement avec les départements de conception, de fabrication, de qualité et autres
- Préparer la documentation technique, suivre l'avancement et faire rapport régulièrement à la direction
- Soutenir l'industrialisation de nouvelles technologies et matériaux

Votre profil
- Diplôme technique complété (Génie Mécanique, Mécatronique, Génie Électrique ou similaire) ou qualification équivalente
- Expérience professionnelle dans la gestion de projets techniques de développement ou d'amélioration (interne)
- Solide connaissance mécanique, idéalement dans le domaine des isolateurs électriques ou composants haute tension
- Expérience avec les méthodes Lean, Six Sigma ou approches similaires d'amélioration est un plus
- Style de travail structuré, orienté solutions, avec de fortes compétences en communication
- Excellentes compétences en allemand et en anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral

En savoir plus sur nous
Nos méthodes de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser votre performance personnelle et professionnelle, en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et évoluer.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:

descriptionByLocale.it:
In qualità di ingegnere del servizio sul campo HITACHI ENERGY LTD, sei responsabile dell'installazione, della manutenzione e della riparazione dei nostri prodotti e sistemi direttamente al cliente in Svizzera. Garantisci le prestazioni e la disponibilità ottimali dei sistemi e quindi un contributo significativo alla soddisfazione dei nostri clienti. È possibile ottenere questo risultato effettuando installazioni, messa in servizio, manutenzione e riparazioni su prodotti e sistemi HITACHI ENERGY, soprattutto nelle aree di alta tensione, trasmissione e distribuzione di energia. Analisi degli errori e correzione di apparecchiature e sistemi elettrici complessi. Creazione di rapporti di servizio e documentazione dopo ogni distribuzione. Consultare i clienti su questioni tecniche e opzioni di ottimizzazione. formazione del personale del cliente nella gestione delle strutture. Rispetto alle normative di sicurezza e agli standard di qualità. Volontà di viaggiare in Svizzera e occasionalmente all'estero. Partecipazione al servizio on-call (piket) al di fuori delle ore di lavoro regolari. Formazione continua e aggiornamento delle competenze sui nuovi prodotti e tecnologie. Formazione tecnica completata (ad esempio elettricista, ingegnere elettronico, automatista) o studi (ad esempio ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria energetica). Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nel campo del servizio o della manutenzione di impianti elettrici, idealmente nel settore dell'energia. La conoscenza approfondita della tecnologia ad alta tensione, dei sistemi di commutazione e di controllo è vantaggiosa. Uso sicuro delle apparecchiature di misura e di prova. Buona conoscenza del tedesco in parola e scrittura (Swiss tedesco è un vantaggio), così come una buona conoscenza dell'inglese. La conoscenza del francese è un vantaggio. Forte capacità di problem solving e capacità di pensiero analitico. Alto grado di iniziativa, responsabilità e orientamento del cliente. Valida patente di guida categoria B. Volontà a lavorare ore flessibili e viaggi. Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
• Offriamo emozionante e variegato
• Compiti con grande stile creativo e interessanti opportunità di formazione e sviluppo. Puoi aspettarti attività e progetti interessanti e diversificati, tra cui operazioni offshore, un team consolidato e dinamico e una cultura aziendale aperta. Inoltre, si beneficia di un pacchetto di servizio attraente con viaggi fissi e pacchetti di cibo, nonché una voce nella scelta di alloggio.
descriptionByLocale.en:
As a field service engineer at HITACHI ENERGY LTD, you are responsible for the installation, maintenance and repair of our products and systems directly at the customer in Switzerland. You ensure the optimal performance and availability of the systems and thus make a significant contribution to the satisfaction of our customers. You can achieve this by carrying out installations, commissioning, maintenance and repairs on HITACHI ENERGY products and systems, especially in the areas of high voltage, energy transmission and distribution. Error analysis and correction of complex electrical equipment and systems. Creation of service reports and documentation after each deployment. Advising customers on technical issues and optimization options. training of customer staff in the handling of the facilities. Compliance with safety regulations and quality standards. Willingness to travel within Switzerland and occasionally abroad. Participation in on-call service (piket) outside regular working hours. Continuous training and updating of expertise on new products and technologies. Your background Completed technical training (e.g. electrician, electronics engineer, automatist) or studies (e.g. electrical engineering, energy engineering). Several years of professional experience in the field of service or maintenance of electrical systems, ideally in the energy industry. In-depth knowledge of high-voltage technology, switchgear and control systems is advantageous. Safe use of measuring and test equipment. Good knowledge of German in word and writing (Swiss German is an advantage), as well as good knowledge of English. Knowledge of French is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills and analytical thinking skills. High degree of initiative, responsibility and customer orientation. Valid driving licence category B. Willingness to work flexible hours and travel. More about us
• We offer exciting and varied
• Tasks with great creative leeway as well as attractive further education and development opportunities. You can expect interesting and diverse activities and projects, including offshore operations, a well-established and dynamic team and an open corporate culture. In addition, you benefit from an attractive service package with fixed travel and food packages as well as a say in the choice of accommodation.

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:

You'll lead and empower local sales teams, foster customer relationships, and leverage on digital tools to deliver exceptional service and results. Our Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of GCB and GIS systems for both Transmission (220kV-550kV) and Sub-transmission (60kV-170kV) level, including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, value-added services, troubleshooting, modification, retrofits and replacements. jobs.title: Internship in Large-Scale Software Systems 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity The System and Automation team at the Swiss research center is looking for an intern student with expertise in software engineering, software architecture, or data processing and visualization to contribute to the development of a novel framework for variability management in large-scale software systems. The intern will interact with dynamic and multidisciplinary teams that will supervise and guide the project. If you have a strong technical background, motivation to develop innovative solutions, and you are goal-oriented, this is your opportunity to contribute to a stronger and more sustainable energy future. The duration of the internship is six months. How you'll make an impact Support technology development and research activities related to the design and architecture of industrial software systems Perform state-of-the-art and technology reviews: Benchmark the achieved results against state-of-the-art solutions for the given application Design, prototype, and\/or integrate tools that support the scalable analysis and management of software systems via intuitive visual interfaces Disseminate and report your results with the teams, write technical documentation, propose creative and efficient solutions towards industrial implementation    Your background Enrolled in an MSc program in Computer Science or a related field (Data Science, Machine Learning, Control and Automation Engineering) Strong background in software engineering, software architecture, and\/or data engineering Experience in Python programming, UI\/UX and\/or simulation tools for power electronics (Simulink, PSCAD, PLECS) is strongly appreciated Excellent communication skills, team player attitude, initiative, and creativity Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità Unisciti al nostro team di ingegneria dinamica nel Centro Regionale di Competenza, Europe Hub, come Project Manager Engineering e guida tecnicamente l'esecuzione e la gara di progetti di infrastrutture di alimentazione elettrica all'avanguardia eMobility. comprese soluzioni di ricarica DC per autobus elettrici. Definirai soluzioni tecniche, guiderai sforzi ingegneristici attraverso sistemi di distribuzione MV & LV e apparecchiature di conversione dell'energia e collaborerai con stakeholder interni ed esterni per guidare l'innovazione e l'eccellenza.

Se sei appassionato di mobilità sostenibile e prospera in un ambiente collaborativo e veloce, questa è la tua occasione per avere un impatto reale.

Come farete un impatto - Prendete il comando tecnico nell'esecuzione e nella gara d'appalto di progetti di infrastrutture elettriche eMobility (ad esempio, depositi di autobus, stazioni di ricarica dei terminali), supporto e guida Team di esecuzione e gara d'appalto locali - Disponi di tutte le attività di ingegneria attraverso cicli di vita dei progetti.dalla progettazione alla messa in servizio - al 21a livello interno con unità operative locali responsabili dell'esecuzione e della gara d'appalto, Vendite, R&D, ingegneri dei prodotti, catena di approvvigionamento, team di installazione e messa in servizio del sito e esternamente con clienti, fornitori - Coordinare e supervisionare team di ingegneria a distanza per

attività di ingegneria primaria e secondaria applicabili - Progettazione architetture del sistema di alimentazione, esecuzione di calcoli di sizing e preparazione delle specifiche tecniche - Evaluate provider offre e supporta i processi di approvvigionamento con Supply Chain Management - Fornire competenze tecniche durante le fasi di gara e di esecuzione dei progetti - Tradurre i requisiti dei clienti in soluzioni tecniche ottimizzate e conformi - Lead discussioni tecniche con i clienti, risolvere le query del sito e garantire risultati tempestivi e di alta qualità - Garantire la sicurezza, la conformità e l'eccellenza ingegneristica durante tutto il progetto

Il vostro background - Laurea o laurea magistrale in ingegneria elettrica, con un focus su Power Electronics o Power Systems - 7.10 anni di esperienza in sistemi di distribuzione di energia MV/LV, progettazione e ingegneria di sistemi elettrici - Esperienza con sistemi di alimentazione CC, convertitori di potenza, stoccaggio di energia o filtraggio armonico è un plus - Forte conoscenza di strumenti e software ingegneristici (ad esempio, BIM, CAD, ETAP, MathCAD) - Proattivo, mentalità basata sui risultati con forti competenze di lavoro di squadra e comunicazione - Impegnato per la sicurezza, la qualità e l'apprendimento continuo - Volontà di viaggiare fino al 10% per

incontri con i clienti e i progetti - Fluente in inglese e francese

Più su di noi Lo stipendio minimo per questa posizione nel luogo specificato è il seguente: - Svizzera: a partire da 9 8.800 CHF - Italia: 44,800 EUR L'offerta finale sarà basata su località candidate, competenze e qualifiche, esperienza, e allineato con strutture salariali interne.

Questo ruolo può essere aperto in più posizioni. Se le informazioni sullo stipendio elencate non sono applicabili per la vostra attuale posizione a casa, i dettagli dello stipendio relativi alla vostra posizione saranno discussi con voi in una fase successiva.

jobs.title: Installed Base Manager 40 - 50% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you analytical, structured, and energized by turning complex data into real business impact? Do you want a role with global reach where the data you own becomes a direct lever for Sales, Service, and business growth? Then we have the ideal opportunity for you! As Installed Base Manager at our Product Service Centre in Zurich, you will take ownership of the worldwide installed base for the high voltage products manufactured at our Swiss factories. Based in our Product Management and Marketing team, you will collaborate closely with Country Installed Base Managers around the globe, safeguard the accuracy of service history and asset data, and empower Sales, Service, and technical functions with dashboards and analyses that drive business decisions. How you'll make an impact Safeguard the data quality of the global installed base for our Swiss-manufactured high voltage products Build strong working relationships with our Country Installed Base Managers worldwide, act as their central product counterpart, and jointly identify bottlenecks, opportunities, and priorities Prepare, analyze, and enrich large data sets, identify errors, and continuously improve data quality Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and tailored analyses that empower Service Sales, Area Sales Managers, and technical troubleshooting teams Deliver cross-functional digital analyses and dashboards that create value beyond the installed base scope Ensure a smooth data handover from new business to service in close collaboration with the Quality department, and partner with Field Service Management to keep field data accurate Your background Bachelor's or master's degree in industrial engineering, business informatics, data science, or a related field; open to both recent graduates and candidates with some years of relevant experience Strong analytical mindset and a passion for data quality, with structured and reproducible ways of working Experience with Power BI, or a clear motivation to build up these skills; SAP knowledge is beneficial and SQL is a plus Curiosity and a problem-solver's mindset: you enjoy digging into complex topics and designing pragmatic solutions A balance of vision and adaptability, with comfort in guiding stakeholders through change Strong collaboration and communication skills across functions and regions Fluent English is mandatory; German and any other language are considered an asset More about us We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Sei analitico, strutturato e energizzato trasformando i dati complessi in impatto reale sul business? Vuoi un ruolo con la portata globale dove i dati che possiedi diventano una leva diretta per vendite, servizi e crescita aziendale? Allora abbiamo l'opportunità ideale per voi! Come installato Base Manager presso il nostro Product Service Centre di Zurigo, si prenderanno la proprietà della base installata a livello mondiale per i prodotti ad alta tensione fabbricati nelle nostre fabbriche svizzere. Con sede nel nostro team di Product Management e Marketing, collaborerai a stretto contatto con Country Installed Base Managers in tutto il mondo, salvaguarderai l'accuratezza della cronologia dei servizi e dei dati degli asset, e aumenterai le funzioni Sales, Service e tecniche con dashboard e analisi che guidano le decisioni aziendali. Con la priorità del benessere, costruiamo un posto di lavoro dove il successo personale e organizzativo crescono insieme.

jobs.title: Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead for the Business Unit Transformers to join our innovative and forward-thinking team. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end management of the Material Sustainability pillar, aligning methodologies for environmental impact assessments, defining processes, implementing initiatives, and monitoring progress across the business unit. This is your opportunity to align with business objectives and regulatory requirements, supporting the organization's sustainability goals and making a meaningful impact in the energy industry. How you will make an impact Drive the BU supply chain sustainability strategy, focusing on material sustainability and business alignment. Monitor sustainability trends, regulations, and customer requirements, integrating them into plans and processes. Standardize material sustainability processes and ensure effective implementation across the supply chain. Lead sustainability improvement initiatives, including decarbonization and supplier engagement. Track sustainability performance and drive continuous improvement through data-driven insights. Develop and maintain material sustainability data, enabling consistent LCA, EPD, and PCF assessments. Partner with suppliers and stakeholders to advance emission reduction and sustainable practices. Deliver training and promote best practices across the SCM community. Align and apply methodologies for assessing material environmental impacts in line with evolving standards. Support supplier requirements, material selection, environmental claims, and customer sustainability requests Your background Degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Minimum of 10 years of experience in supply chain management with focus on sustainability, with proven leadership in strategy and roadmap creation, preferably within global or large-scale organizations. Strong expertise in materials sustainability standards such as ISO 14040\/14044, ISO 14067, the Greenhouse Gas Protocol, and related frameworks. Extensive experience with Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), and implementing global sustainability programs related to materials and suppliers. Strong leadership skills with a track record of developing and executing strategic initiatives in complex, international environments. Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to build relationships and inspire change at all organization levels. titleByLocale.fr: Responsable mondial de la durabilité des matériaux MSC (f/m/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità Hitachi Energy è alla ricerca di un Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead for the Business Unit Transformers per unire il nostro team innovativo e avanzato. In questo ruolo, guiderai la gestione end-to-end del pilastro Sostenibilità dei Materiali, allineando le metodologie per la valutazione dell'impatto ambientale, definendo i processi, implementando iniziative e monitorando i progressi nell'unità aziendale. Questa è la tua opportunità di allineare con gli obiettivi aziendali e i requisiti normativi, sostenere gli obiettivi di sostenibilità dell'organizzazione e fare un impatto significativo nel settore dell'energia. Guidare la strategia di sostenibilità della supply chain BU, concentrandosi sulla sostenibilità dei materiali e sull'allineamento degli affari. Monitorare le tendenze, le normative e i requisiti dei clienti, integrandoli in piani e processi. Standardizzare i processi di sostenibilità dei materiali e garantire un'efficace attuazione in tutta la supply chain. Condurre iniziative di miglioramento della sostenibilità, tra cui decarbonizzazione e coinvolgimento dei fornitori. Traccia le prestazioni di sostenibilità e migliora continuamente attraverso le informazioni basate sui dati. Sviluppare e mantenere i dati di sostenibilità dei materiali, consentendo valutazioni LCA, EPD e PCF coerenti. Partner con fornitori e stakeholder per promuovere la riduzione delle emissioni e pratiche sostenibili. Fornire formazione e promuovere le migliori pratiche in tutta la comunità SCM. Allineare e applicare metodologie per la valutazione degli impatti ambientali materiali in linea con gli standard in evoluzione.
• Requisiti dei fornitori di supporto, selezione dei materiali, reclami ambientali e richieste di sostenibilità dei clienti La vostra laurea in Scienze Ambientali, Ingegneria, Gestione della Supply Chain, o un campo relativo. Minimo di 10 anni di esperienza nella gestione della supply chain con particolare attenzione alla sostenibilità, con una consolidata leadership nella creazione di strategia e roadmap, preferibilmente all'interno di organizzazioni globali o su larga scala. Forte competenza in materia di standard di sostenibilità dei materiali come ISO 14040\/14044, ISO 14067, il Greenhouse Gas Protocol e le relative strutture. Ampia esperienza con Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), e l'implementazione di programmi di sostenibilità globale relativi a materiali e fornitori. Forte capacità di leadership con un track record di sviluppo ed esecuzione di iniziative strategiche in ambienti complessi e internazionali. Ottima comunicazione, presentazione e capacità di influenzare, con la capacità di costruire relazioni e ispirare il cambiamento a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione. Crediamo che il grande lavoro prosperi in un ambiente in cui le persone si sentono sinceramente sostenute e abbastanza ricompensate. I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per creare valore reale per ogni individuo – il rifornimento di impegno, le prestazioni e la crescita. Con la priorità del benessere, costruiamo un luogo di lavoro dove il successo personale e organizzativo crescono insieme. Lo stipendio minimo per questa posizione in località specificata: Italia: a partire da 62.200 EUR lordo salario annuo L'offerta finale si baserà sulla posizione del candidato, le competenze e le qualifiche, l'esperienza, e allineato con strutture di pagamento interne. Questo ruolo può essere aperto in più posizioni. Se le informazioni sullo stipendio elencate non sono applicabili per la vostra posizione attuale, i dettagli dello stipendio relativi alla vostra posizione saranno discussi con voi in una fase successiva. La nostra offerta di benefici è su misura in base al vostro paese di lavoro e generalmente include: stipendio competitivo e incentivi Benessere e cura Lasciare a pagamento e non pagati Opzioni di lavoro flessibili Vantaggi che sostengono la vostra sicurezza finanziaria Riceverai informazioni più specifiche durante il processo di reclutamento.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Hitachi Energy sucht einen Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead für die Business Unit Transformers, um sich unserem innovativen und zukunftsweisenden Team anzuschließen. In dieser Funktion leiten Sie das End-to-End-Management der Säule Materialnachhaltigkeit, richten Methoden für Umweltverträglichkeitsprüfungen aus, definieren Prozesse, implementieren Initiativen und überwachen den Fortschritt in der gesamten Geschäftseinheit. Dies ist Ihre Chance, sich an Geschäftszielen und regulatorischen
• Anforderungen auszurichten, die Nachhaltigkeitsziele des Unternehmens zu unterstützen und einen sinnvollen Einfluss auf die Energiewirtschaft zu erzielen. Wie Sie Ihre Wirkung erzielen, treiben Sie die Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie der BU-Lieferkette voran, wobei Sie sich auf materielle Nachhaltigkeit und Geschäftsausrichtung konzentrieren. Überwachen Sie Nachhaltigkeitstrends, Vorschriften und Kundenanforderungen und integrieren Sie diese in Pläne und Prozesse. Standardisieren Sie Materialnachhaltigkeitsprozesse und gewährleisten Sie eine effektive Umsetzung in der gesamten Lieferkette. Leiten Sie Initiativen zur Verbesserung der Nachhaltigkeit, einschließlich Dekarbonisierung und Lieferantenbindung. Verfolgen Sie die Nachhaltigkeitsleistung und fördern Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungen durch datengesteuerte Erkenntnisse. Entwicklung und Pflege von Material-Nachhaltigkeitsdaten, die konsistente LCA-, EPD- und PCF-Bewertungen ermöglichen. Zusammenarbeit mit Lieferanten und Stakeholdern, um die Emissionsreduzierung und nachhaltige Praktiken voranzutreiben. Bereitstellung von Schulungen und Förderung von Best Practices in der gesamten SCM-Community. Anpassung und Anwendung von Methoden zur Bewertung von wesentlichen Umweltauswirkungen im Einklang mit sich entwickelnden Normen. Unterstützung von Lieferantenanforderungen, Materialauswahl, Umweltaussagen und Nachhaltigkeitsanforderungen für Kunden Ihr Hintergrundstudium in Environmental Science, Engineering, Supply Chain Management oder einem verwandten Bereich. Mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung im Supply Chain Management mit Fokus auf Nachhaltigkeit, mit nachgewiesener Führungsrolle in der Strategie- und Roadmap-Erstellung, vorzugsweise in globalen oder großen Organisationen. Starke Expertise in Nachhaltigkeitsstandards für Materialien wie ISO 14040\/14044, ISO 14067, dem Greenhouse Gas Protocol und verwandten Frameworks. Umfangreiche Erfahrung mit Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs) und der Umsetzung globaler Nachhaltigkeitsprogramme in Bezug auf Materialien und Lieferanten. Starke Führungsqualitäten mit einer Erfolgsbilanz bei der Entwicklung und Durchführung strategischer Initiativen in komplexen, internationalen Umgebungen. Hervorragende Kommunikation, Präsentation und beeinflussende Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, Beziehungen aufzubauen und Veränderungen auf allen Organisationsebenen anzuregen. Wir glauben, dass großartige Arbeit in einem Umfeld gedeiht, in dem sich die Menschen wirklich unterstützt und fair belohnt fühlen. Unsere Vorteile sind so konzipiert, dass sie für jeden Einzelnen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen – und so Engagement, Leistung und Wachstum fördern. Indem wir Wohlbefinden priorisieren, bauen wir einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem persönlicher und organisatorischer Erfolg zusammenwachsen. Das Mindestgehalt für diese Position an einem bestimmten Ort: Italien: ab 62.200 EUR Bruttojahresgehalt Das endgültige Angebot wird auf dem Standort, den Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen der Kandidaten, der Erfahrung und den internen Vergütungsstrukturen basieren. Diese Rolle kann an mehreren Standorten offen sein. Wenn die angegebenen Gehaltsinformationen für Ihren aktuellen Standort nicht gelten, werden die für Ihren Standort relevanten Gehaltsdetails zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt mit Ihnen besprochen. Unser Leistungsangebot ist auf Ihr Beschäftigungsland zugeschnitten und umfasst im Allgemeinen: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Anreize Wohlbefinden und Pflege Bezahlter und unbezahlter Urlaub Flexible Arbeitsoptionen Vorteile, die Ihre finanzielle Sicherheit unterstützen Sie erhalten während des Rekrutierungsprozesses spezifischere Informationen.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Hitachi Energy cherche un responsable mondial de la durabilité des matériaux SCM pour les transformateurs de l'unité d'affaires de rejoindre notre équipe innovante et prospective. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez la gestion de bout en bout du pilier Développement durable des matériaux, en alignant les méthodes d'évaluation des impacts environnementaux, en définissant les processus, en mettant en oeuvre des initiatives et en surveillant les progrès dans l'ensemble de l'unité opérationnelle. C'est l'occasion pour vous de vous conformer aux objectifs opérationnels et aux exigences réglementaires, de soutenir les objectifs de durabilité de l'organisation et d'avoir un impact significatif dans l'industrie de l'énergie. Comment vous ferez un impact Conduire la stratégie de durabilité de la chaîne d'approvisionnement BU, en mettant l'accent sur la durabilité matérielle et l'alignement des entreprises. Surveiller les tendances en matière de durabilité, les règlements et les exigences des clients, en les intégrant dans les plans et les processus. Normaliser les processus de durabilité matérielle et assurer une mise en œuvre efficace dans toute la chaîne d'approvisionnement. Diriger les initiatives d'amélioration de la durabilité, y compris la décarbonisation et l'engagement des fournisseurs. Suivre les performances en matière de durabilité et favoriser l'amélioration continue grâce à des données. Élaborer et tenir à jour des données sur la durabilité des matériaux, ce qui permettra d'effectuer des évaluations cohérentes de la LCA, de la DPE et de la PCF. Établir des partenariats avec les fournisseurs et les intervenants pour faire progresser la réduction des émissions et les pratiques durables. Offrir de la formation et promouvoir les pratiques exemplaires dans l'ensemble de la collectivité de MSC. Aligner et appliquer des méthodes d'évaluation des impacts environnementaux matériels conformément aux normes en évolution. Soutenir les exigences des fournisseurs, la sélection des matériaux, les revendications environnementales et les demandes de durabilité des clients Diplôme en sciences de l'environnement, en génie, en gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement ou dans un domaine connexe. Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement en mettant l'accent sur la durabilité, avec un leadership prouvé dans la création de stratégies et de feuilles de route, de préférence au sein des organisations mondiales ou à grande échelle. Forte expertise en matière de normes de durabilité des matériaux, telles que ISO 14067, ISO 14044, le Protocole sur les gaz à effet de serre et les cadres connexes. Expérience approfondie des évaluations du cycle de vie, des déclarations de produits environnementaux et de la mise en oeuvre de programmes mondiaux de durabilité liés aux matériaux et aux fournisseurs. De solides compétences en leadership avec une expérience de développement et d'exécution d'initiatives stratégiques dans des environnements internationaux complexes. Excellente communication, présentation et influence des compétences, avec la capacité d'établir des relations et d'inspirer le changement à tous les niveaux de l'organisation. Plus sur nous Nous croyons que le grand travail prospère dans un environnement où les gens se sentent véritablement soutenus et équitablement récompensés. Nos avantages sont conçus pour créer une valeur réelle pour chaque individu – alimenter l'engagement, la performance et la croissance. En donnant la priorité au bien-être, nous construisons un lieu de travail où la réussite personnelle et organisationnelle se développe ensemble. Le salaire minimum pour ce poste dans un lieu déterminé: Italie: à partir de 62 200 EUR salaire annuel brut L'offre finale sera fondée sur l'emplacement des candidats, les compétences et les qualifications, l'expérience et l'alignement sur les structures de paye internes. Ce rôle peut être ouvert à plusieurs endroits. Si les renseignements sur le salaire énumérés ne s'appliquent pas à votre lieu de résidence actuel, les détails sur le salaire se rapportant à votre lieu de résidence seront discutés avec vous ultérieurement. Notre offre de prestations est adaptée à votre pays d'emploi et comprend généralement : Salaire et incitatifs compétitifs Bien-être et soins Congé payé et non rémunéré Options de travail flexibles Avantages qui soutiennent votre sécurité financière Vous recevrez des informations plus précises pendant le processus de recrutement.

jobs.title: R&D Test Engineer - High Voltage 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity     Join our R&D team within High Voltage Products in Zurich-Oerlikon and contribute to the development of high-voltage circuit breakers that support reliable power transmission worldwide.   In this role, you will   be responsible for   testing and   validating   high-voltage equipment throughout the product development cycle. jobs.title: Network and Security Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity In this challenging role, you will design the network and security architecture for communication networks used in power utilities, wind farms, and other critical infrastructure, based on the modern technology standards. How you'll make an impact You will develop systems in compliance with security standards such as IEC 62443 and NERC-CIP You will implement planned cybersecurity measures on devices and applications You will support the sales organization during the tender phase and in customer discussions With your technical expertise, you will assist the project manager and coordinate with both customers and internal stakeholders You will prepare procedures and operational manuals tailored to customer requirements You will conduct risk assessments as part of project execution, in alignment with IEC 62443, to identify and evaluate cybersecurity risks within industrial automation systems and ensure appropriate security measures are implemented Your background You have a degree in power engineering, electrical engineering, information technology, or equivalent professional experience, along with experience in communication networks and system architectures in industrial or infrastructure environments You are proficient in cybersecurity technologies, LAN\/WAN networks, peripheral devices, and operating systems including MS Windows (Server, AD) and Linux You demonstrate strong communication skills, team spirit, and the ability to work independently Excellent command of English is required You are motivated to help build a new business area and actively support the transition to a cybersecure work approach, assisting engineers in adopting cybersecurity best practices More about us We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

Our solutions play a key role in enabling the integration of renewable energy into modern power grids while improving overall system efficiency. To strengthen our Control Engineering team, we are looking for a motivated and hands-on Project Control Engineer with a strong interest in power electronics and control systems. If you are a fast learner with a structured and proactive mindset, and you enjoy combining engineering work with real-world applications — this is your opportunity.   How you'll make an impact Plan and execute control engineering aspects of projects, including hardware and software concepts, specifications, and documentation Coordinate technical interfaces between customers, sub-suppliers, and jobs.title: Internship in Dielectric Withstand of Gas Insulated Switchgear 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join an innovative and collaborative engineering team shaping the future of high-voltage technology. You will contribute to the development of next-generation SF6-free circuit breakers in a supportive and knowledge-sharing environment. This role offers hands-on experience with simulations, measurements, and cutting-edge dielectric tools. You will learn from experienced mentors while taking ownership of meaningful tasks. The position supports continuous learning, curiosity, and professional growth. How you'll make an impact Support development of SF6-free high-voltage circuit breakers through simulations and testing Perform electric field simulations to support dielectric design decisions Analyze and evaluate breakdown measurements and test results Maintain and expand breakdown databases including alternative gases Use and further develop internally established dielectric evaluation tools Contribute to design optimization through simulation insights and basic testing Collaborate with interdisciplinary project teams in circuit breaker development Conduct literature research on breakdown and flashover phenomena and extract relevant data including simulations (Comsol) Your background Enrolled Student (preferably Master) or Graduate in Physics, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or a related field Strong programming skills and interest in Python, Matlab, or Excel Fluent in written and spoken English Analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills Ability to work collaboratively and take initiative independently Interest in high-voltage systems and simulation-based engineering (Comsol, CAD, Creo) More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.
